title: Quantitative measurement of viscosity in two-dimensional electron fluids
summary_zh: 本文研究二维电子流体粘度测量。采用磁阻法，实现电阻率和粘度同时测量。实验表明，电子电子散射率与温度线性相关。
summary_en: This paper investigates the quantitative measurement of viscosity in two-dimensional electron fluids. Magnetoresistance method is used for simultaneous measurement of resistivity and viscosity. Experiments show that the electron-electron scattering rate scales linearly with temperature.
insights: 创新点：磁阻法实现粘度测量
方法亮点：同时测量电阻率和粘度
关键发现：电子电子散射率与温度线性相关
insights_en: Novelty: Magnetoresistance method for viscosity measurement
Method highlight: Simultaneous measurement of resistivity and viscosity
Key finding: Linear relationship between electron-electron scattering rate and temperature
abstract: Electron hydrodynamics is an emerging framework that describes dynamics of interacting electron systems as conventional fluids. Although evidence for hydrodynamic-like transport has been reported in a variety of two-dimensional materials, precise quantitative measurement of the core parameter, electron viscosity, remains challenging. In this work, we demonstrate that magnetoresistance in Corbino-shaped graphene devices offers a simultaneous ohmmeter and viscosometer capability, allowing us to disentangle the individual ohmic and viscous contributions to transport, even near viscous-ohmic crossover. In both monolayer and bilayer graphene, the effective electron-electron scattering rate scales linearly with temperature, deviating markedly from the T 2 dependence expected in conventional Fermi liquids. Instead, it is consistent with a recently identified tomographic fluid regime, theoretically predicted to be generic for two-dimensional electron systems.

title: An introduction to zero-order optimization techniques for robotics
summary_zh: 本文介绍零阶优化技术在机器人领域的应用。方法上，通过数学教程阐述随机搜索。结果表明，该方法有助于理解多种机器人算法。
summary_en: This paper introduces zero-order optimization techniques in robotics. It presents a mathematical tutorial on random search, demonstrating its utility in understanding various robotics algorithms.
insights: 创新点：零阶优化在机器人中的应用
方法亮点：随机搜索的数学教程
关键发现：多种算法的统一理解
insights_en: Novelty: Application of zero-order optimization in robotics
Method highlight: Mathematical tutorial on random search
Key finding: Unified understanding of various algorithms
abstract: Zero-order optimization techniques are becoming increasingly popular in robotics due to their ability to handle non-differentiable functions and escape local minima. These advantages make them particularly useful for trajectory optimization and policy optimization. In this work, we propose a mathematical tutorial on random search. It offers a simple and unifying perspective for understanding a wide range of algorithms commonly used in robotics. Leveraging this viewpoint, we classify many trajectory optimization methods under a common framework and derive novel competitive RL algorithms.

title: SimPoly: Simulation of polymers with machine learning force fields derived from first principles
summary_zh: 本文开发了一种基于第一原理的机器学习力场，用于聚合物模拟。方法上，仅使用量子化学计算训练力场，预测了多种聚合物的宏观性质。实验表明，该力场在预测聚合物密度方面与经典力场相当或更准确。
summary_en: This paper develops a machine learning force field derived from first principles for polymer simulation. The method trains the force field using quantum-chemical calculations alone, predicting bulk properties across a range of polymers. Experiments show that this force field is as accurate or more accurate in predicting polymer densities than established classical force fields.
insights: 创新点：基于第一原理开发机器学习力场
方法亮点：仅使用量子化学计算训练力场
关键发现：力场在预测聚合物密度方面表现优异
insights_en: Novelty: Developing a machine learning force field based on first principles
Method highlight: Training the force field using only quantum-chemical calculations
Key finding: The force field excels in predicting polymer densities
abstract: Polymers are a versatile class of materials with widespread industrial applications. Advanced computational tools could revolutionize their design, but the complex, multi-scale nature of polymers poses significant modeling challenges. Classical force fields often lack the accuracy and transferability that polymers demand, while quantum-chemical methods are prohibitively expensive for the large systems and long timescales involved. Here we develop a fast, scalable machine learning force field and show that, trained on quantum-chemical calculations alone, without any experimental data, it predicts measured bulk properties across a broad range of polymers. It reproduces polymer densities as accurately as, or better than, established classical force fields and captures the glass transition signature in the density-temperature curve, enabling the prediction of glass transition temperatures. To accelerate progress in this domain, we release a benchmark of experimental bulk properties for 130 polymers and an accompanying quantum-chemical dataset, laying the foundation for a fully in silico design pipeline for next-generation polymeric materials. The authors develop a machine learning force field trained only on quantum-chemical data that can reproduce measured key polymer properties such as densities and glass transition temperatures.

title: Non-halogen aqueous electrolytes for four-electron iodine conversion
summary_zh: 开发非卤素水系电解质实现四电子碘转化。利用阴离子化学调节界面微环境和分子相互作用。实现无卤素电解质中的可逆转化。
summary_en: This paper develops non-halogen aqueous electrolytes for four-electron iodine conversion. Anionic chemistry is used to regulate the interfacial microenvironment and molecular interactions, enabling reversible conversion in halogen-free electrolytes.
insights: 创新点：非卤素水系电解质实现四电子碘转化
方法亮点：利用阴离子化学调节界面微环境
关键发现：无卤素电解质中的可逆转化
insights_en: Novelty: Non-halogen aqueous electrolytes for four-electron iodine conversion
Method highlight: Utilizing anionic chemistry to regulate the interfacial microenvironment
Key finding: Reversible conversion in halogen-free electrolytes
abstract: Abstract Accessing reversible four-electron iodine redox chemistry in aqueous metal–iodine batteries offers a promising route towards high-energy aqueous energy storage, but has conventionally relied on highly concentrated, corrosive halogen-containing electrolytes to stabilize reactive hypervalent iodine cations through interhalogen complexation 1–9 . Here we show a kosmotropic anion–polar anion–nucleophilic species (Nuc) electrolyte framework that harnesses anionic chemistry to coordinate the interfacial microenvironment and molecular interactions, enabling reversible four-electron iodine conversion in halogen-free aqueous electrolytes. Polar anions establish a water-deficient, anion-enriched interfacial microenvironment, whereas kosmotropic anions regulate water–Nuc interactions to increase the availability of Nuc for stabilizing hypervalent iodine cations through Nuc–I + –Nuc halogen bonds. This electrolyte framework is validated across diverse Nuc and in both aqueous Zn–I 2 and Al–I 2 batteries. Moving beyond conventional interhalogen stabilization, these findings establish a distinct electrolyte chemistry framework and represent a mechanistic shift for reversible multi-electron iodine chemistry in aqueous environments.

title: AnyNav: Visual neuro-symbolic friction learning for off-road navigation
summary_zh: 研究越野导航问题。提出基于神经符号的视觉摩擦估计和导航框架。结合视觉感知和物理模型。
summary_en: Studies off-road navigation. Introduces a vision-based friction estimation and navigation framework grounded in neuro-symbolic principles. Integrates visual perception with a physical model.
insights: 创新点：结合视觉感知和物理模型
方法亮点：神经符号方法应用于导航
关键发现：提高导航在复杂环境中的泛化能力
insights_en: Novelty: Integrates visual perception with a physical model
Method highlight: Applies neuro-symbolic methods to navigation
Key finding: Improves navigation generalization in complex environments
abstract: Off-road navigation is critical for a wide range of field robotics applications from planetary exploration to disaster response. However, it remains a longstanding challenge due to unstructured environments and the inherently complex terrain–vehicle interactions. Traditional physics-based methods struggle to accurately capture the nonlinear dynamics underlying these interactions, while purely data-driven approaches often overfit to specific motion patterns, vehicle geometries, or platforms, limiting their generalization in diverse, real-world scenarios. To address these limitations, we introduce AnyNav, a vision-based friction estimation and navigation framework grounded in neuro-symbolic principles. Our approach integrates neural networks for visual perception with symbolic physical models for reasoning about terrain-vehicle dynamics. To enable learning in a self-supervised manner for real-world settings, we adopt the imperative learning paradigm, where a bilevel optimization framework leverages physics-based optimization for training the friction network. This explicit incorporation of physical reasoning substantially improves generalization across terrains, vehicle types, and operating conditions. Leveraging the predicted friction coefficients, we further develop a physics-informed navigation system capable of generating physically feasible, time-efficient paths together with corresponding speed profiles. We demonstrate that AnyNav seamlessly transfers from simulation to real-world robotic platforms, exhibiting strong robustness across different four-wheeled vehicles and diverse off-road environments.

title: A unified framework for robots that influence humans over long-term interaction
summary_zh: 研究机器人如何通过长期交互影响人类决策。提出统一框架，控制机器人影响以避免负面影响。
summary_en: Investigates how robots influence human decisions through long-term interaction. Proposes a unified framework to control robot influence to avoid negative impacts.
insights: 创新点：提出统一框架控制机器人影响
方法亮点：结合控制算法与人类行为研究
关键发现：机器人影响需受控以避免负面效应
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed a unified framework to control robot influence
Method highlight: Combining control algorithms with human behavior research
Key finding: Robot influence needs to be controlled to avoid negative effects
abstract: Robot actions influence the decisions of nearby humans. Here, influence refers to intentional change: robots influence humans when they shift the human’s behavior in a way that helps the robot complete its task. Imagine an autonomous car trying to merge; by proactively nudging into the human’s lane, the robot causes human drivers to yield and provide space. Influence is often necessary for seamless interaction. However, if influence is left unregulated and uncontrolled, robots will negatively impact the humans around them (e.g., autonomous cars that repeatedly merge in front of humans may cause human drivers to become more aggressive). Prior works have begun to address this problem by creating a variety of control algorithms that seek to influence humans. Although these methods are effective in the short-term, they fail to maintain influence over time as the human adapts to the robot’s behaviors. In this paper we therefore present an optimization framework that enables robots to purposely regulate their influence over humans across both short - term and long - term interactions. Here, the robot maintains its influence by reasoning over a dynamic human model which captures how the robot’s current choices will impact the human’s future behavior. Our resulting framework serves to unify current approaches: we demonstrate that state-of-the-art methods are simplifications of our underlying formalism. Our framework also provides a principled way to generate influential policies: in the best case the robot exactly solves our framework to find optimal, influential behavior. But when solving this optimization problem becomes impractical, designers can introduce their own simplifications to reach tractable approximations. We experimentally compare our unified framework to state-of-the-art baselines and ablations, and demonstrate across simulations and user studies that this framework is able to successfully influence humans over repeated interactions. See videos of our experiments here: https://youtu.be/nPekTUfUEbo .

title: Recent advances in multi-agent human trajectory prediction: A comprehensive review
summary_zh: 综述了基于深度学习的多智能体轨迹预测的最新进展。分类现有方法，并强调多智能体轨迹预测的关键挑战和未来研究方向。
summary_en: Reviews the latest advancements in deep learning-based multi-agent trajectory prediction. Categorizes existing methods and highlights key challenges and future research directions in multi-agent trajectory prediction.
insights: 创新点：综述了多智能体轨迹预测的最新进展
方法亮点：分类现有方法
关键发现：强调未来研究方向
insights_en: Novelty: Reviews the latest advancements in multi-agent trajectory prediction
Method highlight: Categorizes existing methods
Key finding: Emphasizes future research directions
abstract: With the emergence of powerful data-driven methods in human trajectory prediction (HTP), gaining a finer understanding of multi-agent interactions lies within hand’s reach, with important implications in areas such as social robot navigation, autonomous driving, and crowd modeling. This survey reviews some of the most recent advancements in deep learning-based multi-agent trajectory prediction, focusing on studies published between 2020 and 2025. We categorize the existing methods based on their architectural design, their input representations, and their overall prediction strategies. Furthermore, we highlight key challenges and future research directions in multi-agent HTP.

title: Time optimal quadrotor maneuver: From optimality analysis to trajectory planning
summary_zh: 研究生成最小时间四旋翼轨迹，优化不同任务范围下的轨迹表示。
summary_en: Addresses the problem of generating minimum-time quadrotor trajectories with efficient scaling across varying mission ranges.
insights: 创新点：最小时间四旋翼轨迹生成
方法亮点：轨迹表示的优化
关键发现：任务范围下的轨迹表示
insights_en: Novelty: Generation of minimum-time quadrotor trajectories
Method highlight: Optimization of trajectory representation
Key finding: Trajectory representation across varying mission ranges
abstract: We address the problem of generating minimum-time quadrotor trajectories that scale efficiently across varying mission ranges. This problem is rooted in a fundamental trade-off between representing complex trajectories and optimizing them efficiently at scale. Specifically, as mission ranges expand, existing methods require more decision variables to represent the trajectory, causing computation times to surge. Furthermore, since total duration is an optimization variable, finding an adequate time-discretization resolution of the trajectory representation demands meticulous initialization and repeated, parameter-heavy tuning. We demonstrate that piecewise polynomials, despite being criticized as unsuitable for bang-bang control due to their inherent smoothness, are in fact a sensible choice for representing time-optimal trajectories for a quadrotor, as long as the selected polynomial segment number is larger than the number of switching points along the optimal trajectory of specific tasks. To establish an upper bound on the number of switching points, we analyze the time-optimality conditions and show that optimal maneuvers between two points follow a structured control policy: the most complex body rate exhibits a bang-singular-bang-singular-bang structure, while the collective thrust is bang-bang with at most seven bang arcs. This analysis enables a near-minimal trajectory parameterization alongside an efficient, scalable framework that reliably yields time-optimal waypoint trajectories over long mission distances. In numerical evaluations, our method demonstrates scale-invariant computation time and memory usage, taking virtually the same processing time across mission distances from 217 m to 2269 m, and the gaps to optimal times are minimal, falling between 1.7% and 3.5%. Finally, we validate the approach in real-world flight experiments, reaching speeds of up to 9.1 m/s.

title: Open-world panoptic segmentation
summary_zh: 提出一种通用方法Con2MAV，用于开放世界全景分割。实验表明其在开放世界分割中的强大能力。
summary_en: A general method, Con2MAV, for open-world panoptic segmentation is proposed. Experiments highlight its compelling capabilities in open-world segmentation.
insights: 创新点：提出开放世界全景分割的通用方法。
方法亮点：Con2MAV方法在开放世界分割中表现优异。
关键发现：该方法在多种数据集上均表现出色。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposing a general method for open-world panoptic segmentation.
Method highlight: Con2MAV performs excellently in open-world segmentation.
Key finding: The method shows compelling performance across various datasets.
abstract: Robots need to be able to understand their surroundings in order to operate safely and robustly, and to interact with the surrounding environment. Robots deployed in unconstrained real-world scenarios must additionally be able to deal with novel situations and objects that have never been seen before. In this article, we tackle the problem of open-world panoptic segmentation, that is, the task of discovering new semantic categories and new object instances at test time, while enforcing consistency among the categories that we incrementally discover. We present Con2MAV, a general method for open-world panoptic segmentation. Experiments across a wide range of datasets, from road scenes to underwater environments, highlight its compelling capabilities in open-world segmentation and its competitive performance on known classes. We will open-source the implementation of our approach upon acceptance. In addition, we propose PANIC ( P anoptic AN omalies I n C ontext), a benchmark for evaluating open-world segmentation tasks in autonomous driving scenarios. This dataset, recorded with a multi-modal sensor suite mounted on a car, and then manually annotated, provides high-quality, pixel-wise annotations of anomalous objects at both semantic and instance level. PANIC contains 800 images, more than 50 unknown classes, that is, classes that do not appear in the training set, and over 4000 object instances, providing a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating open-world segmentation methods in autonomous driving scenarios. We provide competitions for multiple open-world segmentation tasks on a hidden test set. Our dataset and competitions are available at https://www.ipb.uni-bonn.de/data/panic .

title: DEFT: Differentiable branched discrete elastic rods for modeling furcated DLOs in real-time
summary_zh: 提出DEFT框架实时模拟分支DLO。结合物理模型与学习，准确模拟BDLO动态，包括动态传播。
summary_en: This paper introduces the DEFT framework for real-time modeling of furcated DLOs. It combines a physics-based model with learning to accurately model BDLO dynamics, including dynamic propagation.
insights: 创新点：DEFT框架模拟分支DLO
方法亮点：结合物理模型与学习
关键发现：准确模拟BDLO动态
insights_en: Novelty: DEFT framework for modeling furcated DLOs
Method highlight: Combining a physics-based model with learning
Key finding: Accurate modeling of BDLO dynamics
abstract: Autonomous wire harness assembly requires robots to manipulate complex branched cables with high precision and reliability. A key challenge to automating this process is accurately predicting how branched cables deform during manipulation. Although well-studied for single Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs), existing methods do not extend directly to Branched DLOs (BDLOs), whose junctions couple bending, twisting, and stretching across branches in ways that connecting multiple DLO models cannot capture. To address this challenge, this paper introduces Differentiable discrete branched Elastic rods for modeling Furcated DLOs in real-Time (DEFT), a framework that combines a differentiable physics-based model with learning to: (1) accurately model BDLO dynamics, including dynamic propagation at junctions and grasping in the middle of a BDLO, (2) achieve real-time inference, and (3) support planning for dexterous BDLO manipulation. DEFT introduces momentum-conserving junction constraints to explicitly capture cross-branch coupling, combines analytical gradients with branch-parallel computation for efficient parameter learning and inference, and uses a residual Graph Neural Network to reduce errors accumulated during long-horizon predictions. Experiments on six physical BDLOs with different topologies and material properties demonstrate formulation-level generalization: the same DEFT formulation and residual-GNN architecture are applied across all evaluated BDLOs without redesign, while the physical and learned parameters are fitted separately for each BDLO. DEFT outperforms state-of-the-art physics-based and learning-based methods. Over five-second recursive open-loop predictions, DEFT achieves RMSEs of 0.93–2.14 cm across the evaluated BDLOs while supporting real-time inference at over 100 Hz. In real-world planning, DEFT achieves success rates of 36/40 for shape matching, 40/40 for parent-branch insertion, and 16/20 for child-branch insertion. These results demonstrate DEFT’s ability to provide accurate, efficient, and planning-compatible BDLO predictions for autonomous wire-harness manipulation.

title: Giant elastoresistance in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene
summary_zh: 研究魔角扭曲双层石墨烯中的巨弹性电阻。施加单轴应变。发现弹性电阻与温度相关。
summary_en: Investigates giant elastoresistance in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene. Applied uniaxial strain. Found elastoresistance is temperature-dependent.
insights: 创新点：魔角扭曲双层石墨烯中的巨弹性电阻
方法亮点：单轴应变实验
关键发现：弹性电阻与温度相关
insights_en: Novelty: Giant elastoresistance in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene
Method highlight: Uniaxial strain experiment
Key finding: Elastoresistance is temperature-dependent
abstract: Strongly correlated and topological phases in moiré materials are exquisitely sensitive to lattice geometry at both atomic and superlattice length scales. Twist angle, pressure, and strain directly modify the lattice and thus act as highly effective tuning parameters. Here, we examined electrical transport in twisted bilayer graphene subjected to continuous uniaxial strain. Near the magic angle (≈1.1°), devices exhibited a pronounced elastoresistance that depended on band filling and temperature, with a gauge factor more than two orders of magnitude larger than that of conventional metals. In selected doping regimes, the elastoresistance exhibited a Curie-Weiss–like temperature divergence. We discuss possible microscopic origins, including nematic fluctuations and enhanced electronic entropy from fluctuating isospin moments. Our work establishes uniaxial strain as a versatile probe of correlated physics in a moiré material.

title: Emergent long-tailed dynamics in spin ice
summary_zh: 揭示磁系统自发产生的长尾动力学。展示高驱动频率下磁单极激发的非遍历随机动力学。模型中加热时间对初始状态敏感，呈长尾分布。
summary_en: Unveils spontaneously emerging long-tailed dynamics in a magnetic system. Demonstrates nonergodic stochastic dynamics of magnetic monopole excitations at high driving frequencies. The heating time in the model is extremely sensitive to different initial-state realizations and follows a long-tailed power-law distribution.
insights: 创新点：揭示磁系统中的长尾动力学
方法亮点：通过经典自旋系统展示自旋冰物理现象
关键发现：加热时间对初始状态敏感，呈长尾分布
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals long-tailed dynamics in magnetic systems
Method highlight: Demonstrates spin-ice physics in classical spin systems
Key finding: Heating time is highly sensitive to initial-state realizations and follows a long-tailed distribution
abstract: In this study, we reveal long-tail dynamics spontaneously arising from a magnetic system. Specifically, we consider a classical spin system and demonstrate the emergence of a spin-ice physics when drive-induced heating is well suppressed. We show that at high driving frequencies, magnetic monopole excitations exhibit nonergodic stochastic dynamics characterized by power-law-distributed trapping times with long tails—a behavior that persists even in the absence of driving. At intermediate driving frequencies, the system eventually heats up to an infinite-temperature state. However, contrary to conventional wisdom of Floquet heating, the heating time in our model is extremely sensitive to different initial-state realizations and also follows a long-tailed power-law distribution, which arise specifically due to periodic driving. We show that an effective short-range attractive interaction between monopoles is responsible for the long-tailed distributions observed in both monopole and heating dynamics.

title: Scale-rich network-based metamaterials
summary_zh: 研究提出将网络异质性嵌入机械超材料的设计框架。方法上，通过引入网络异质性。实验表明，实现长程尺度异质性。
summary_en: The study introduces a design framework that embeds network heterogeneity into mechanical metamaterials. The method involves introducing network heterogeneity. Experiments show that orders-of-magnitude heterogeneity in ligament lengths, thicknesses, and connectivity is achieved.
insights: 创新点：将网络异质性嵌入机械超材料
方法亮点：引入网络异质性
关键发现：实现长程尺度异质性
insights_en: Novelty: Embedding network heterogeneity into mechanical metamaterials
Method highlight: Introducing network heterogeneity
Key finding: Achieving long-range heterogeneity in ligament lengths, thicknesses, and connectivity
abstract: Materials, at their essence, are networks defined by homogeneity: uniform bonds, fixed thicknesses and discrete length scales. Mechanical metamaterials, while representing structurally more diverse microstructures, remain defined by the homogeneity of their unit cells, pore sizes or repeating features1,2. In contrast, as network science has revealed, real-world and biological systems—from the Internet to the brain—derive their function from broad, multiscale variability in connectivity and link length3–6. Here we introduce scale-rich metamaterials, a design framework that embeds network heterogeneity into mechanical metamaterials, achieving orders-of-magnitude heterogeneity in ligament lengths, thicknesses and connectivity. Governed by only two parameters, scale-rich networks span orders of magnitude in structural features, overcoming previous constraints in metamaterial design. Translating these network models into physically realizable materials, we use simulations and experiments to show that scale-rich metamaterials exhibit properties inaccessible to traditional single-scale systems, including highly tunable elastic anisotropy, delocalized nonlinear deformation with high energy absorption, enhanced energy dissipation under dynamic loading and programmable elastic-wave control. This network-based framework establishes a minimal and universal model for engineering multifunctional materials whose mechanical behaviour emerges directly from scale diversity, and also opens avenues of enquiry for network science itself. A network-science-based framework that embeds network heterogeneity into mechanical metamaterials is used to produce scale-rich metamaterials that exhibit properties inaccessible to traditional single-scale systems.

title: The quantum agreement theorem
summary_zh: 研究量子力学中的量子协议定理。采用三体有限维设置。证明共同确定性导致一致性。
summary_en: Studies the quantum agreement theorem in quantum mechanics. Employed a finite-dimensional tripartite setting. Proves common certainty leads to consistency.
insights: 创新点：量子协议定理证明
方法亮点：三体有限维设置
关键发现：共同确定性导致一致性
insights_en: Novelty: Proof of the quantum agreement theorem
Method highlight: Finite-dimensional tripartite setting
Key finding: Common certainty leads to consistency
abstract: Intersubjective consistency asks when different observers of a physical system, reasoning from a shared theory, will agree on their probability assessments. Classical probability theory provides a benchmark in the form of the Agreement Theorem [R. J. Aumann, Ann. Stat. 4 , 1236–1239 (1976)]. We study the quantum mechanics (QM) analog to the classical Agreement Theorem in a finite-dimensional tripartite setting in which two observers obtain information via local projective measurements. We represent their mutual awareness by common certainty, which is formally an infinite hierarchy of certainty operators concerning the probability of an event of interest. We first prove that if the observers’ measurements commute with one another and with the property of interest, common certainty forces their probability assessments to coincide, thereby recovering a QM analog to the classical Agreement Theorem. We then construct a one-parameter family of qutrit–qubit–qubit models in which one observer’s measurement does not commute with the property and common certainty of disagreement occurs—a distinctively QM phenomenon. The mechanism is coherence between branches distinguished by one but not the other observer’s measurement. When measurement outcomes are stored in a classical register, the resulting dephasing removes this coherence and restores agreement. Finally, we prove that QM does not permit the extreme 0 - 1 configuration in which Alice is certain of a property and is also certain that Bob is certain of its negation. These results aim to turn debate in QM about observer-dependent facts into precise mathematical conditions for when intersubjective agreement or disagreement in QM can be sustained.

title: Atmospheric O 2 reveals a strengthening ocean carbon sink and a stagnant net land sink since 1990
summary_zh: 大气氧气和二氧化碳观测显示，海洋碳汇增强，陆地碳汇停滞。挑战现有模型预测能力。
summary_en: Observations of atmospheric oxygen and carbon dioxide reveal a strengthening ocean carbon sink and a stagnant net land sink since 1990, challenging the predictive ability of existing models.
insights: 创新点：利用大气氧气和二氧化碳数据
方法亮点：评估海洋和陆地碳汇变化
关键发现：挑战现有模型预测能力
insights_en: Novelty: Utilizing atmospheric oxygen and carbon dioxide data
Method highlight: Assessing changes in ocean and land carbon sinks
Key finding: Challenging the predictive ability of existing models
abstract: The global ocean and land biosphere absorb roughly half of fossil fuel carbon dioxide (CO 2 ) emissions. The temporal evolution of these sinks remains difficult to quantify owing to data sparsity. Leveraging 30+ years of atmospheric oxygen (O 2 ) and CO 2 observations, we find that the ocean carbon sink increased by 0.63 ± 0.19 petagrams of carbon per year per decade (Pg C year −1 decade −1 ) (a mean of 2.8 ± 0.4 Pg C year −1 ), accounting for 35% of fossil emissions between 1990 and 2019. The net land sink shows no robust trend (with a mean of 1.0 ± 0.5 Pg C year −1 , accounting for 13% of fossil emissions), despite large decadal variability. These results challenge many process-based model simulations of the land and ocean sinks, questioning their ability to accurately predict future climate states.

title: Odyssey: An automotive lidar-inertial odometry dataset with GNSS-denied situations
summary_zh: 本文提出Odyssey数据集，用于LIO和SLAM系统评估。数据集包含长时间GNSS拒绝环境下的LIO数据，弥补了现有数据集的不足。
summary_en: This paper presents the Odyssey dataset for evaluating LIO and SLAM systems. The dataset contains LIO data under prolonged GNSS-denied situations, addressing the limitations of existing datasets.
insights: 创新点：提出Odyssey数据集，解决GNSS拒绝环境下的LIO评估问题。
方法亮点：提供长时间GNSS拒绝环境下的LIO数据。
关键发现：数据集弥补了现有数据集的不足。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes the Odyssey dataset to address LIO evaluation under GNSS-denied situations.
Method highlight: Provides LIO data under prolonged GNSS-denied situations.
Key finding: The dataset addresses the limitations of existing datasets.
abstract: The development and evaluation of Lidar-Inertial Odometry (LIO) and Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) systems require a precise reference trajectory. The Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) is often used as a foundation for this, but its signals can be unreliable in obstructed environments due to multi-path effects or loss-of-signal. While existing datasets compensate for sporadic GNSS loss by incorporating Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) measurements, the commonly used systems do not permit prolonged study of GNSS-denied environments due to accumulated drift. Consequently, existing automotive benchmarks are typically restricted to short GNSS-denied segments. To close this gap, we present Odyssey, an automotive LIO dataset featuring: (1) prolonged, previously unseen GNSS-denied environments with reference trajectories enabled by a navigation-grade Ring Laser Gyroscope (RLG)-based RTK/INS; (2) a large and diverse collection of 36 sequences that range from rural outdoor environments to urban and indoor scenarios; and (3) experimentally validated uncertainties, allowing for precise quantification of reference error. Besides providing data for LIO, Odyssey also supports place recognition tasks through threefold trajectory repetition and integration of external mapping data via precise geodetic coordinates. All data, dataloader and supplementary material are available online at https://odyssey.uni-goettingen.de/ .

title: From a single demonstration to a general policy for contact-rich manipulation
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种从单一演示到通用策略的四个阶段学习演示（LfD）管道，通过环境约束将通用任务结构从难以建模的实例特定细节中分离出来。
summary_en: This paper presents a four-stage Learning from Demonstration (LfD) pipeline that incrementally constructs a general policy for contact-rich manipulation from a single human demonstration, separating general task structure from hard-to-model instance-specific details using environmental constraints.
insights: 创新点：提出基于单一演示的LfD管道
方法亮点：使用环境约束分离任务结构和细节
关键发现：在多阶段接触丰富的操作任务中实现高成功率
insights_en: Novelty: Proposal of an LfD pipeline from a single demonstration
Method highlight: Separating task structure from details using environmental constraints
Key finding: High success rate in multi-stage contact-rich manipulation tasks
abstract: We present a four-stage Learning from Demonstration (LfD) pipeline that incrementally constructs a general policy for multi-stage contact-rich manipulation from a single human demonstration. The pipeline is built around a crucial inductive bias—environmental constraints—that separates general task structure from hard-to-model instance-specific details. We show that, on top of this inductive bias, simple and well-established components are already sufficient to build an interactive LfD system that generalizes to unseen variations in object pose, local geometry, and contact conditions under real-world uncertainty. We validate the system on seven real-world multi-stage contact-rich manipulation tasks and achieve over 90% success across tasks. These results establish environmental constraints as fundamental building blocks for efficient generalization in learning from demonstration. The project website can be found at https://lfdec.github.io/ .

title: Dynamical geometric modes in non-Euclidean plates
summary_zh: 研究非欧几里得板中的动态几何模式，探讨残余应力和几何形状对运动的影响。
summary_en: Investigates dynamic geometric modes in non-Euclidean plates, exploring the impact of residual stresses and geometric shapes on motion.
insights: 创新点：非欧几里得板中的动态几何模式研究
方法亮点：残余应力和几何形状分析
关键发现：鞍形最小曲面稳定性
insights_en: Novelty: Study of dynamic geometric modes in non-Euclidean plates
Method highlight: Analysis of residual stresses and geometric shapes
Key finding: Stability of saddle minimal surfaces
abstract: Continuum elastic shells with residual stresses can exhibit complex motions that require vanishing elastic energy to excite, also called geometric zero modes, enabling them to be driven by weak and generic energy inputs. Despite recent interest in these modes, we understand very little about their dynamical properties. Plates with a curved, rather than flat, in-plane geometry, also called non-Euclidean plates, are one example in which residual stresses and geometry combine to produce a continuum of ground states. The plate can explore these states through a geometric zero mode when it has the shape of a minimal surface—a surface with zero mean curvature. We demonstrate that a non-Euclidean plate with the shape of a saddle minimal surface exhibits the predicted continuous stability, but this degeneracy is ultimately lifted by aging. Despite developing a preferred configuration, the zero mode remains the softest mode. Using a combination of analytical theory and experiments, we show that the elastodynamics of this soft mode is captured by the dynamics of a damped pendulum. A periodic driving uncovers resonance phenomena in this pendulum mode, such as small oscillations and steady rotations, but mixes with an additional flapping mode at high frequencies.

title: Controlled flight of an insect-scale flapping-wing robot via integrated onboard sensing and computation
summary_zh: 研究展示了一种仅靠机载感知和计算就能稳定飞行的昆虫级扑翼机器人。
summary_en: The study presents an insect-scale flapping-wing robot capable of stable flight with solely onboard sensing and computation.
insights: 创新点：实现了昆虫级机器人的自主飞行
方法亮点：结合传感器、估计器和低级控制器
关键发现：机器人可进行厘米级定位飞行
insights_en: Novelty: Achieved autonomous flight for insect-scale robots
Method highlight: Integrated sensor suite, estimators, and a low-level controller
Key finding: Robot achieves centimeter-scale positional flight accuracy
abstract: Aerial insects can effortlessly navigate dense vegetation, whereas similarly sized aerial robots typically depend on offboard sensors and computation to maintain stable flight. This disparity restricts insect-scale robots to operation in motion-capture environments, substantially limiting their applicability to tasks such as search-and-rescue operations and precision agriculture. In this work, we present a 1.29-gram aerial robot capable of hovering and tracking trajectories with solely onboard sensing and computation. The combination of a sensor suite, estimators, and a low-level controller achieved centimeter-scale positional flight accuracy. In addition, we developed a hierarchical controller in which a human operator provides high-level commands to direct the robot’s motion. In a 30-second flight experiment conducted outside a motion-capture system, the robot avoided obstacles and ultimately landed on a sunflower. This level of sensing and computational autonomy represents a notable advancement for the aerial microrobotics community, opening further opportunities to explore onboard planning and power autonomy.

title: Spontaneous gas film expansion at an oil–water interface
summary_zh: 研究揭示了油水界面自发形成气膜的现象。方法上，通过微结构限制和气泡引入，实现气膜形成。实验表明，气膜的形成降低了局部压力，促进了溶解空气的吸收。
summary_en: This study reveals the spontaneous formation of a gas film at an oil-water interface. The method involves microstructural confinement and bubble introduction to achieve gas film formation. Experiments show that the formation of the gas film lowers local pressure, promoting the uptake of dissolved air.
insights: 创新点：揭示油水界面自发形成气膜的现象
方法亮点：微结构限制和气泡引入实现气膜形成
关键发现：气膜的形成降低了局部压力，促进了溶解空气的吸收
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the spontaneous formation of a gas film at an oil-water interface
Method highlight: Microstructural confinement and bubble introduction to achieve gas film formation
Key finding: The formation of the gas film lowers local pressure, promoting the uptake of dissolved air
abstract: Spontaneous interfacial separation of oil and water, by inserting a gas film between the two liquids, is thermodynamically unfavorable because the oil–water interface is replaced by oil–gas and water–gas interfaces with a higher combined interfacial energy. Here, we demonstrate that microstructural confinement enables this transition after bubble introduction through the coupling of wetting, capillarity, and gas transport. Spontaneous oil imbibition into a water-submerged micropillar array, together with local contact-line pinning, deforms the oil–water interface into a metastable meniscus and generates a local pressure deficit in the confined oil. This deficit, combined with the bubble’s interfacial configuration, lowers its air partial pressure and promotes dissolved-air uptake from the surrounding water. Geometric confinement, reduced oil pressure, and low oil–gas interfacial tension favor bubble lateral invasion of adjacent oil-filled cells over vertical extrusion. As the gas front advances, meniscus relaxation and oil redistribution promote further wetting, renewing the capillary conditions that support gas film propagation. We develop a coupled transport-capillarity framework that captures these morphological transitions and predicts a characteristic timescale for gas film evolution, determined by the interaction among geometry, capillarity, and gas-phase transport. Spatially varying the microstructure further controls the propagation pathway and morphology of the gas film. These findings show how favorable wetting can support an energetically costly interfacial transformation through a confinement-induced capillary pressure field, providing a general mechanism for gas-mediated separation in confined multiphase systems.

title: History-dependent droplet friction driven by contact-line aging
summary_zh: 研究证明接触线摩擦受滑动速度和接触历史共同影响，静态摩擦增强，动态摩擦减弱。
summary_en: The study demonstrates that contact-line friction is jointly influenced by sliding velocity and contact history, with enhanced static friction and weakened dynamic friction.
insights: 创新点：证明接触线摩擦受滑动速度和接触历史共同影响
方法亮点：静态摩擦增强，动态摩擦减弱
关键发现：摩擦随接触历史变化
insights_en: Novelty: Demonstrating that contact-line friction is jointly influenced by sliding velocity and contact history
Method highlight: Enhanced static friction and weakened dynamic friction
Key finding: Friction changes with contact history
abstract: The motion of liquid droplets on solid surfaces is commonly described by contact-line friction, which is generally assumed to increase monotonically with instantaneous velocity. However, such a velocity-only description cannot explain why static droplet friction can exceed dynamic friction or why contact-line friction can become velocity-weakening. Here, we demonstrate that contact-line friction depends jointly on sliding velocity and contact history. Using self-assembled alkylsilane monolayers as molecularly tunable substrates and ionic liquids as low-volatility model liquids, we observe pronounced history-dependent strengthening of contact-line friction on solid-like monolayers, manifested as time-enhanced static friction and velocity-weakening dynamic friction. Both effects are progressively suppressed as the surface is tuned toward a more liquid-like state with a lower density of pinning defects, either by reducing the monolayer chain length or by increasing temperature. We attribute this behavior to nanoscopic contact-line aging, whereby contact-line segments thermally fluctuate and progressively occupy interfacial defects, leading to a progressive increase in contact-line pinning. An aging-based model quantitatively captures the history-dependent onset friction and the low-velocity friction dynamics in our system, while similar logarithmic strengthening across diverse liquid–substrate systems suggests broader applicability of the constitutive framework. These findings establish the coupled effects of contact history and sliding velocity on contact-line friction, extending dynamic wetting beyond velocity-only descriptions and providing a physical basis for controlling macroscopic droplet transport through nanoscale interfacial design.

title: Elastic tricriticality at the collapse of magnetic order in a valence fluctuating Eu-based compound
summary_zh: 研究发现在Eu基化合物中，磁性秩序崩溃时存在弹性三重临界点。
summary_en: This study finds the presence of elastic tricriticality at the collapse of magnetic order in a valence fluctuating Eu-based compound.
insights: 创新点：揭示了电子关联与晶体弹性的非微扰耦合。
方法亮点：通过EuPd2(Si1-xGex)2单晶实验验证。
关键发现：三重临界点的弹性特性与关联长度相关。
insights_en: Novelty: Revealed nonperturbative coupling between electronic correlations and crystal elasticity.
Method highlight: Experimental verification using single crystals of EuPd2(Si1-xGex)2.
Key finding: Elastic tricriticality characteristics related to correlation length.
abstract: Spin and charge fluctuations are key for understanding the properties of materials with strongly correlated electrons, but their coupling to the atomic crystal lattice is often assumed to be weak and perturbative. In this work, we demonstrate that at tricritical points (TCPs), that are associated with electronic correlations, a coupling to crystal elasticity is generically nonperturbative. It will modify the tricritical universality class leading to elastic tricriticality , characterized by a compressibility that diverges in a universal manner with the correlation length. To test this scenario experimentally, we use single crystals of EuPd 2 (Si 1− x Ge x ) 2 where, depending on x and pressure, magnetic order collapses due to strong valence fluctuations. First, we confirm the presence of a TCP for x ≈ 0.1 by using complementary probes, in particular, measurements of relative length changes under control of temperature and He-gas pressure. Second, by studying the elastic response, we uncover clear signatures of elastic tricriticality, notably a drastically enhanced compressibility.

title: Stereodynamical control of a four-atom reaction: HD + OH → D + H 2 O
summary_zh: 研究展示了在HD+OH→D+H2O反应中，立体动力学对反应的影响。
summary_en: This study shows the influence of stereodynamics on the HD + OH → D + H2O reaction.
insights: 创新点：首次研究分子反应中的立体动力学。
方法亮点：结合高分辨率交叉束散射和全维度量子动力学研究。
关键发现：观察到明显的立体动力学效应。
insights_en: Novelty: First study of stereodynamics in molecular reactions.
Method highlight: Combined high-resolution crossed-beam scattering and full-dimensional quantum dynamical study.
Key finding: Pronounced stereodynamic effects observed.
abstract: To date, studies of differential steric effect in reactive collisions have been limited to atom + molecule systems. How stereodynamics is affected when the other reactant is also a molecule remains an open question. Here, we present a combined high-resolution crossed-beam scattering and full-dimensional quantum dynamical study of the HD ( v = 1, j = 2) + OH → D + H 2 O reaction, in which the HD molecular axis was initially prepared either parallel or perpendicular to the relative velocity using the stimulated Raman pumping scheme. The OH reactant was unpolarized and in its ground vibrational state, with a rotational temperature of ~85 K in the experiment, and was restricted to the ground rovibrational state in the theory. Pronounced stereodynamic effects are observed in both the backward scattering intensity and the product angular distributions. Detailed analysis of scattering wavefunctions reveals that the initial m = ±2 states access a noncoplanar dynamical transition state, distinct from that accessed by m = 0 ( m denotes the projection of j along the direction of relative velocity). The nonzero dihedral angle, a geometric degree of freedom absent in triatomic reactions, leads to reduced reactivity and enhances sideward scattering for the perpendicular configuration, while leaving the product rovibrational state distributions essentially unchanged. In addition, the alignment of the HD rotational angular momentum is preserved in the rotational direction of the product H 2 O.

title: Geodetic observations in West Antarctica reveal geodynamically consistent 3D mantle viscosity
summary_zh: 西南极冰盖变化导致地壳运动和重力变化。本研究通过三维地幔粘弹性结构模型，解释了这些变化。
summary_en: Changes in West Antarctic ice sheets lead to crustal movements and gravity changes. This study explains these changes using a 3D mantle viscoelastic structure model.
insights: 创新点：三维地幔粘弹性结构模型的应用
方法亮点：结合地质观测和地球物理模型
关键发现：地幔粘弹性结构对冰盖变化的影响
insights_en: Novelty: Application of a 3D mantle viscoelastic structure model
Method highlight: Combining geodetic observations and geophysical models
Key finding: The impact of mantle viscoelastic structure on ice sheet changes
abstract: The rapid ice loss in West Antarctica since the 1990s has led to substantial ice surface lowering, regional bedrock uplift, and gravity reduction, as measured by geodetic observations. The bedrock (crustal) motions and gravity changes result from glacial isostatic adjustment (GIA), a process controlled by Earth’s viscoelastic properties and deglaciation history. In this study, we present GIA models with geodynamically consistent three-dimensional mantle viscoelastic structures and reconstructed ice history for Antarctica from 1900 to 2020, which explain both the observed Global Navigation Satellite System crustal motions and Gravity Recovery and Climate Experiment gravity changes in West Antarctica. This study demonstrates that a mantle rheology including a weak asthenosphere and temperature-dependent viscosity is consistent with both mantle convection at million-year timescales and ongoing decadal GIA occurring in West Antarctica.

title: Carbon dioxide and amorphous water ices in the debris disk around β Pictoris
summary_zh: 通过詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜观测，发现β Pictoris星周围尘埃盘存在无定形水和二氧化碳冰。
summary_en: Observations with the James Webb Space Telescope reveal amorphous water ice and carbon dioxide ice in the debris disk around β Pictoris.
insights: 创新点：发现无定形水和二氧化碳冰
方法亮点：使用詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜
关键发现：星际介质中的冰形成条件
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of amorphous water ice and carbon dioxide ice
Method highlight: Use of the James Webb Space Telescope
Key finding: Conditions for ice formation in the interstellar medium
abstract: The star β Pictoris is orbited by a dusty debris disk, within which planet formation is occurring. The outer disk is sufficiently far from the star that volatile molecules are expected to freeze into solid ices. We observed the β Pictoris disk in the near-infrared using the James Webb Space Telescope. The spectrum shows features due to amorphous water ice (<7% crystallinity) and carbon dioxide (CO 2 ) ice in both the 12 CO 2 and 13 CO 2 isotopologues. We infer that the CO 2 ice is intimately mixed with the water ice at a ratio of 1:10. This implies that the ices formed in cold conditions, likely in the interstellar medium. Frequent collisions within the debris disk are required to explain the observed uniform distribution of icy dust grains.

title: Fixing the power transmission crisis
summary_zh: 研究提出解决电力传输危机的方法。通过实验、学习和现有技术选项。旨在协调各方利益。
summary_en: This study proposes methods to fix the power transmission crisis. Through experimentation, learning, and existing technology options. Aimed at aligning stakeholders' interests.
insights: 提出解决电力传输危机的方法
实验和学习作为解决手段
协调各方利益
insights_en: Proposes methods to fix the power transmission crisis
Experimentation and learning as means of solution
Aligning stakeholders' interests
abstract: Experimentation, learning, and existing regulatory and technology options could help align stakeholders

title: Direct monitoring of breaching in deltaic submarine landslides
summary_zh: 直接监测加拿大Homathko三角洲海底滑坡，揭示滑坡类型。
summary_en: Direct underwater monitoring of fully submarine landslides at Homathko Delta in western Canada, indicating breaching-type failure.
insights: 海底滑坡直接监测
滑坡类型识别
海底结构设计
insights_en: Direct monitoring of submarine landslides
Identification of landslide types
Design of seabed structures
abstract: Submarine landslides threaten seabed infrastructure and trigger the transport of globally important amounts of sediment, carbon, and pollutants to deep-sea environments. However, fully submarine landslides have never been directly monitored in nature. Past hypotheses for their failure mechanism and dynamics therefore remain unvalidated for natural settings, including that prolonged upslope-migrating failures (breaching) occur in sandy seafloor environments. In this work, we present direct underwater monitoring of fully submarine landslides at Homathko Delta in western Canada that retrogress slowly upslope, indicating breaching-type failure. Their prolonged rather than instantaneous nature has important implications for the stress that seabed structures must be designed to withstand. Prolonged landslides also initiate sustained sediment flows (turbidity currents) that efficiently transport sediment, carbon, and pollutants further offshore.

title: Tracking danger on the peaks
summary_zh: 高山地区气候变化加剧，监测系统需更新。冰川融化引发连锁反应，监测重点需调整。
summary_en: Climate change accelerates in high mountain areas, necessitating updates to monitoring systems. Melting glaciers can trigger a cascade of disasters, requiring adjustments in monitoring priorities.
insights: 创新点：关注高山地区气候变化
方法亮点：更新监测系统
关键发现：冰川融化引发连锁反应
insights_en: Novelty: Focus on climate change in high mountain areas
Method highlight: Updating monitoring systems
Key finding: Melting glaciers trigger a cascade of disasters
abstract: The Earth is warming, but not all regions are warming equally. In high mountain areas, temperatures are generally increasing by 1.5 to 2 times the global average, sometimes with devastating consequences. A small or gradual change in the mountain cryosphere—perhaps progressive thawing of frozen ground or a flood from a small glacial lake—can suddenly turn into a cascade of catastrophes with enormous ramifications. Monitoring systems for the cryosphere in high mountain areas have traditionally been designed to look at individual components and changes. What are the temperature and depth of the permafrost, or how much area is covered by snow, and what is the related avalanche danger? Many of the monitoring and warning systems were designed for historical patterns of snowfall or rainfall, and a river gauge may no longer be adequate if there is greater flow in the rainy season, or increased sediment that could damage the gauge.

title: Thermal infrared pollination by beetles
summary_zh: 热红外辐射助甲虫传粉。植物热能作为信号，提高传粉效率。
summary_en: Beetles use thermal infrared radiation for pollination, with plant heat energy serving as a signal to enhance pollination efficiency.
insights: 创新点：发现热红外辐射在传粉中的作用
方法亮点：植物热能作为传粉信号
关键发现：提高传粉效率
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of the role of thermal infrared radiation in pollination
Method highlight: Plant heat energy as a pollination signal
Key finding: Enhancing pollination efficiency
abstract: Heat from thermogenic plants serves as a signal to pollinators

title: The cryosphere beyond a planetary safe operating space
summary_zh: 冰冻圈功能超出安全操作空间，人类面临长期风险。需采取措施保护地球系统韧性。
summary_en: The cryosphere's functions exceed the planetary safe operating space, posing long-term risks to human societies and ecosystems, necessitating measures to safeguard Earth system resilience.
insights: 创新点：提出冰冻圈安全操作空间概念
方法亮点：评估冰冻圈对地球系统的影响
关键发现：冰冻圈功能超出安全操作空间
insights_en: Novelty: Proposal of the cryosphere safe operating space concept
Method highlight: Assessing the impact of the cryosphere on the Earth system
Key finding: The cryosphere's functions exceed the safe operating space
abstract: The cryosphere plays a vital role in regulating planetary dynamics and habitability, yet it remains unclear whether its essential functions remain within a safe operating space (SOS) amid Anthropocene change. Here, we propose a cryosphere SOS and systematically evaluate its contributions to Earth system resilience using the planetary boundaries framework. Multiple lines of evidence indicate an accelerating and partly irreversible loss of cryospheric integrity, driven by amplifying feedbacks. Key cryospheric control variables either have left or are committed to departing from Holocene-like conditions. We conclude that the cryosphere has breached its SOS and is on a trajectory that locks in long-term risks for human societies and ecosystems. Safeguarding planetary resilience therefore requires explicit consideration of cryosphere change and its interactions across the Earth system.

title: Quantifying the hierarchical topological decay of fluid knots
summary_zh: 分析流体结点的拓扑级联衰减。使用代数方法量化拓扑状态，揭示衰减过程。
summary_en: Analysis of the hierarchical topological decay of fluid knots using algebraic methods to quantify topological states and reveal the decay process.
insights: 创新点：代数方法量化拓扑状态
方法亮点：分析流体结点衰减过程
关键发现：揭示拓扑衰减规律
insights_en: Novelty: Algebraic methods for quantifying topological states
Method highlight: Analysis of fluid knot decay process
Key finding: Revealing the law of topological decay
abstract: In this paper we analyze the hierarchical topological cascade of knotted and linked filaments associated with the natural decay of superfluid vortex tangles. This is done by using an algebraic reformulation of knot polynomial invariants to quantify the topological states of the cascade process. By interpreting the evolutionary paths associated with vortex knot dynamics as geodesic flows in an appropriate knot polynomial space defined by adapted Jones polynomials [X. Liu, R. L. Ricca, J. Phys. A Math. Theor. 45 , 205501 (2012).], we introduce an entanglement index to quantify the probability density of occurrence of each topological state. By this method we analyze all prime knots, links, and composites up to 8 crossings, and show that this measure detects accurately the decreasing topological complexity observed in simulations and laboratory experiments. By a comparative analysis carried out with data based on an alternative measure (complexity degree), we show that this entanglement index proves to be a more robust and reliable quantifier. The theoretical framework proposed here can be applied to other types of physical systems, where networks of filamentary structures are subject to continuous topological change and reorganization.

title: Diffusional depth profiling using electrochemiluminescence microscopy
summary_zh: 研究电化学发光显微镜扩散深度分析，发现增加发光体浓度可获取3D信息，通过调节浓度比控制发射层扩散。
summary_en: Studies diffusional depth profiling with electrochemiluminescence microscopy, finds that increasing luminophore concentration enables access to 3D information, and controlling emission layer diffusion by tuning concentration ratio.
insights: 创新点：提出电化学发光显微镜扩散深度分析新方法
方法亮点：通过调节浓度比控制发射层扩散
关键发现：增加发光体浓度获取3D信息
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes a new method for diffusional depth profiling with electrochemiluminescence microscopy
Method highlight: Controls emission layer diffusion by tuning concentration ratio
Key finding: Gaining 3D information by increasing luminophore concentration
abstract: Electrochemiluminescence (ECL) microscopy has emerged as a powerful 2D imaging technique with exceptional spatial resolution, enabling visualization of biological entities, nanomaterials, and multiphase systems. Conventional ECL experiments rely on coreactant concentrations in large excess of the luminophore to generate a bright signal in the vicinity of the electrode. While effective for surface interrogation, this confinement limits resolution in the z-dimension, making 3D imaging challenging. Here, we show that introducing an excess of luminophore enables access to 3D information through diffusion of the emission layer away from the electrode. By tuning the concentration ratio of tris(2,2’-bipyridine)ruthenium(II) ([Ru(bpy) 3 ] 2+ ) to tri-n-propylamine (TPrA), we control emission layer diffusivity. Initially, ECL arises from heterogeneous oxidation of both species at the electrode. As TPrA is depleted, the mechanism shifts to chemiluminescence, where [Ru(bpy) 3 ] 3+ oxidizes TPrA, generating a diffusing emissive layer that extends in the z-direction over time. Simulations and scanning electrochemical microscopy capture these diffusion profiles and highlight the role of concentration ratios. We apply this “diffusional depth profiling” to spirulina algae and spheroid cell models, insulating bodies that block light coming from the evolving emissive layer, revealing 3D morphology. This work uncovers the important influence of time and concentration on ECL emission layer expansion for depth profiling micro-to-mesoscale entities across biology and materials science.

title: Physical distancing to prevent influenza-like illness on a college campus: The eX-FLU trial
summary_zh: 研究评估大学校园中鼓励物理距离以预防流感样疾病的效果。随机对照试验显示，干预措施有效减少病例。
summary_en: The study evaluates the effectiveness of encouraging physical distancing to prevent influenza-like illness on a college campus. A randomized controlled trial shows that the intervention reduces cases effectively.
insights: 创新点：评估物理距离干预措施在校园中的应用
方法亮点：随机对照试验设计
关键发现：干预措施有效减少流感样疾病病例
insights_en: Novelty: Evaluating the application of physical distancing interventions in campus settings
Method highlight: Randomized controlled trial design
Key finding: Intervention effectively reduces cases of influenza-like illness
abstract: Public health recommendations often advise people to isolate when infected with influenza-like illness (ILI) with the goal of promoting physical distancing and limiting face-to-face interactions when risk of transmission is highest. Because isolation may have negative consequences, it is important to carefully assess whether encouragement to physically distance actually prevents cases of ILI. College campuses can be especially vulnerable to outbreaks of ILI and are ideal environments for assessing the impact of encouragement-to-physically-distance interventions. The eX-FLU cluster-randomized trial followed 579 students on a college campus over a ten-week period during flu season to evaluate such an intervention. Students in the trial were randomized to receive the intervention—encouragement to isolate in their dorm room when symptomatic for ILI—or control. Evaluating the effect of this intervention is challenging because of dependence between students in the trial and an anticipated spillover effect of the intervention. Moreover, while the intervention was designed to affect both face-to-face interactions and ILI infections, the effect on ILI infections is of primary public health interest. In this paper, a randomization-based testing procedure is proposed to assess the intervention effect specifically on ILI infections in the presence of dependent data and spillover effects. The testing procedure is shown theoretically and empirically to control the type I error rate and have good statistical power to detect an intervention effect in trials similar to eX-FLU. When applied to the eX-FLU data, this testing procedure gives moderate evidence that the intervention reduced ILI infections.

title: Elastic interactions of mechanically polarizable cells
summary_zh: 研究提出机械极化细胞的弹性相互作用理论。通过分析弹性相互作用能量，发现细胞间存在短程相互作用。
summary_en: The study proposes an analytical theory of the elastic interactions of mechanically polarizable cells. By analyzing the elastic interaction energy, it finds a short-ranged interaction between cells.
insights: 创新点：提出机械极化细胞的弹性相互作用理论
方法亮点：分析弹性相互作用能量
关键发现：细胞间存在短程相互作用
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed an analytical theory of the elastic interactions of mechanically polarizable cells
Method highlight: Analyzing elastic interaction energy
Key finding: Short-ranged interaction between cells
abstract: Cells mechanically interact through the deformations they generate in their surrounding extracellular matrix. We present an analytical theory of the elastic interactions between cells that actively adapt their forces in response to local deformations of their environment. Cells are represented as localized contractile force generators, modeled as polarizable point force dipoles, whose adaptive forces are determined self-consistently with those of surrounding cells. Analysis of the associated elastic interaction energy identifies a generic short-ranged interaction arising from the mutual adaptation of cellular forces. This induced-dipole interaction is analogous to the van der Waals interaction between molecules and likewise is shown to be generally attractive for cells that enhance contractility in response to stretch. Furthermore, unlike the long-ranged elastic interaction between nonpolarizable force-dipoles, that peaks at intermediate matrix stiffness and then weakens as the matrix softens, the induced-dipole interaction strengthens monotonically as the matrix softens and can reverse the interaction from being repulsive at long cell distances to being attractive at short separations. Analytical calculations are presented to illustrate the mutual polarization of forces in pairs of interacting cells on a substrate. The identification of a generic, short-range cohesive elastic interaction between cells is important for understanding cell behavior at short separations and provides a physical mechanism driving cell accumulation on soft substrates.

title: Elastic tricriticality at the collapse of magnetic order in a valence fluctuating Eu-based compound
summary_zh: 研究Eu基化合物中磁序崩溃的弹性三临界性，揭示晶体弹性与电子关联的强耦合。
summary_en: This study investigates the elastic tricriticality at the collapse of magnetic order in a valence fluctuating Eu-based compound, revealing strong coupling between crystal elasticity and electronic correlations.
insights: 创新点：揭示晶体弹性与电子关联的强耦合
方法亮点：采用单晶实验方法
关键发现：弹性三临界性的存在
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing strong coupling between crystal elasticity and electronic correlations
Method highlight: Using single crystal experimental methods
Key finding: Existence of elastic tricriticality
abstract: Spin and charge fluctuations are key for understanding the properties of materials with strongly correlated electrons, but their coupling to the atomic crystal lattice is often assumed to be weak and perturbative. In this work, we demonstrate that at tricritical points (TCPs), that are associated with electronic correlations, a coupling to crystal elasticity is generically nonperturbative. It will modify the tricritical universality class leading to elastic tricriticality , characterized by a compressibility that diverges in a universal manner with the correlation length. To test this scenario experimentally, we use single crystals of EuPd 2 (Si 1− x Ge x ) 2 where, depending on x and pressure, magnetic order collapses due to strong valence fluctuations. First, we confirm the presence of a TCP for x ≈ 0.1 by using complementary probes, in particular, measurements of relative length changes under control of temperature and He-gas pressure. Second, by studying the elastic response, we uncover clear signatures of elastic tricriticality, notably a drastically enhanced compressibility.

title: A Robust Physics-Informed Implicit Neural Representation for Speed-of-Sound Image Reconstruction in USCT
summary_zh: 提出了一种基于物理信息的隐式神经网络表示，用于超声计算机断层扫描（USCT）中的声速图像重建。
summary_en: A robust physics-informed implicit neural representation for speed-of-sound image reconstruction in ultrasound computed tomography (USCT) is proposed.
insights: 创新点：开发基于物理信息的神经网络表示
方法亮点：应用于USCT声速图像重建
关键发现：提高重建稳定性
insights_en: Novelty: Development of a physics-informed neural representation
Method highlight: Application in USCT speed-of-sound image reconstruction
Key finding: Improved reconstruction stability
abstract: As a promising imaging modality, ultrasound computed tomography (USCT) holds significant clinical value by providing quantitative parametric maps, such as speed of sound (SOS), in addition to high-resolution anatomical structures. While full-waveform inversion (FWI) is optimal for high-fidelity SOS reconstruction, its severe non-convexity frequently causes traditional discrete grid-based methods to trap in local minima, yielding anatomical artifacts that hinder clinical translation. Here, we propose POLARIS, an unsupervised continuous neural field inversion framework that utilizes spatial continuity as implicit regularization to stabilize the complex FWI optimization. Tailored to the circular acquisition geometry of USCT, we design a scale-aware radially-modulated polar encoding that effectively mitigates radial-angular sampling non-uniformity. We leverage the deterministic nature of the coupling background velocity to extract anatomical boundaries directly from acoustic signals, serving as a structural prior to preserve tissue integrity. Optimization is facilitated by a stochastic shot-batched optimization strategy, leveraging global parameter coupling to update the SOS field from subset emissions and accelerate convergence. Extensive validations on numerical and in vivo breast and musculoskeletal data demonstrate the POLARIS's higher accuracy and structural fidelity. Comparisons with MRI confirm the high anatomical consistency of the reconstructed SOS images. Notably, the framework maintains robust reconstruction performance under sparse-view configurations, highlighting its potential for accelerated USCT acquisition with reduced measurement requirements.

title: One-Step Rectified Flow Reconstruction with Spectral Weighting for Limited-angle Cardiac CT
summary_zh: 提出了一种基于谱加权的单步校正流重建方法，用于有限角度心脏CT重建，以加速重建过程。
summary_en: A one-step rectified flow reconstruction with spectral weighting for limited-angle cardiac CT is proposed to accelerate the reconstruction process.
insights: 创新点：提出单步校正流重建方法
方法亮点：利用谱加权加速重建
关键发现：提高重建效率
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed one-step rectified flow reconstruction
Method highlight: Utilizing spectral weighting to accelerate reconstruction
Key finding: Improved reconstruction efficiency
abstract: Limited-angle cardiac computed tomography (CT) suffers from severe directional artifacts and resolution degradation due to missing wedges in the frequency domain. Diffusion-based reconstruction methods have demonstrated strong artifact suppression capabilities but typically require iterative sampling at a high computational cost. To accelerate limited-angle CT reconstruction, we propose a rectified-flow framework trained with paired supervision for fast inference. Instead of generating images from Gaussian noise, the model learns a deterministic transport from artifact-contaminated Feldkamp-Davis-Kress (FDK) reconstructions to full-view reference images. A 2.5D slice-context modeling strategy is introduced to exploit inter-slice information while reconstructing only the central slice, improving structural consistency. Furthermore, we introduce a reconstruction-aware spectral loss that applies frequency-domain supervision to an approximate endpoint reconstruction inferred from the predicted flow velocity. By embedding spectral priors into the learning objective and using one-step rectified-flow inference (a single network evaluation), the proposed framework achieves fast reconstruction while preserving image fidelity. Experiments on XCAT simulations and clinical cardiac CT data show superior quantitative performance and substantially reduced inference time compared to the state-of-the-art baselines. A qualitative review by an experienced cardiac radiologist further suggests improved visualization of motion-sensitive coronary structures with reduced motion blur.

title: AI rivals take on one of physics’ hardest math problems
summary_zh: OpenAI与Anthropic团队解决物理难题。Yang-Mills理论取得进展。
summary_en: OpenAI and Anthropic team tackle one of physics' hardest math problems. Progress on Yang-Mills theory is made.
insights: OpenAI与Anthropic团队解决难题
Yang-Mills理论取得进展
物理难题研究
insights_en: OpenAI and Anthropic team solve难题
Progress on Yang-Mills theory
Physics problem research
abstract: OpenAI and an Anthropic-associated group make progress on Yang-Mills theory, the math behind fundamental forces

title: Meso–microporous zeolitic materials with thin walls containing ordered 10-ring channels
summary_zh: 本研究提出新型介孔-微孔沸石材料，通过电子透射成像建立结构模型。材料具有10环通道，加速扩散同时保持选择性。
summary_en: This study introduces novel meso-microporous zeolitic materials with 10-ring channels, accelerated diffusion with preserved selectivity, and established structural models via electron ptychographic imaging.
insights: 创新点：新型介孔-微孔沸石材料
方法亮点：电子透射成像建立结构模型
关键发现：10环通道加速扩散
insights_en: Novelty: Novel meso-microporous zeolitic materials
Method highlight: Structural models established via electron ptychographic imaging
Key finding: 10-ring channels accelerate diffusion
abstract: Aluminosilicate zeolites offer exceptional size and shape selectivity but suffer from diffusion limitations imposed by subnanometer micropores. Intrinsically meso–microporous zeolites integrate mesopores with micropores to create interconnected pathways that accelerate diffusion while preserving selectivity, yet their synthesis remains challenging. In this study, we report NJU120-5 and NJU120-7, intrinsically meso–microporous aluminosilicates that integrate micropores with mesopores enclosed by two-T-atom-thick walls containing 10-ring channels, forming a fully interconnected three-dimensional pore network. Their plausible framework models were established on the basis of advanced electron ptychographic imaging, revealing representative quasi-rectangular mesopores in calcined NJU120-5 with a uniform width of ~12 angstroms and lengths from 41 to 162 angstroms. Both materials exhibit high porosity, strong Brønsted acidity, and enhanced performance in heavy-oil cracking, delivering high yields of valuable fuels with suppressed coke formation.

title: Quiet within, chaos without: Turbulence shelters drive selective particle capture and release
summary_zh: 研究提出湍流避难所，通过尺度筛选涡流，驱动粒子定向运输。避难所内部与外部流之间建立浓度对比，选择性受粒子几何形状、惯性、热波动和静电作用控制。
summary_en: This study introduces turbulence shelters that filter eddies by scale, driving directional particle transport, establishing concentration contrasts between the interior and surrounding flow, with selectivity controlled by particle geometry, inertia, thermal fluctuations, and electrostatic forces.
insights: 创新点：湍流避难所概念
方法亮点：涡流尺度筛选
关键发现：粒子定向运输
insights_en: Novelty: Turbulence shelters concept
Method highlight: Eddy scale filtering
Key finding: Directional particle transport
abstract: Turbulence is chaotic, yet its fluctuations follow a structured, nonequilibrium energy cascade unconstrained by the equilibrium theorems that limit passive energy extraction from molecular gases. Here, we introduce turbulence shelters: hollow shells with a single aperture that filter eddies by scale, sustaining gradients in fluctuation intensity that drive directional particle transport despite zero mean fluid flux. Across three orders of magnitude in size, shelters establish particle concentration contrasts between their interior and the surrounding flow, with selectivity controlled by particle geometry, inertia, thermal fluctuations, and electrostatic forces. At the microscale, shelters discriminate particles differing by tens of nanometers independently of material composition. These results establish a design principle for selective filtration: Geometry that compartmentalizes turbulent fluctuations can harness ambient eddies to direct particle transport.

title: Interpenetrating bottlebrush elastomer for low-loss soft ultrasonic interfaces
summary_zh: 研究设计了一种新型互穿梳状弹性体，降低剪切模量同时减少剪切损失，提高软超声界面低损耗。
summary_en: This study designs a novel interpenetrating bottlebrush elastomer that lowers shear modulus without increasing shear loss, enhancing low-loss soft ultrasonic interfaces.
insights: 创新点：新型互穿梳状弹性体
方法亮点：降低剪切模量减少剪切损失
关键发现：提高软超声界面低损耗
insights_en: Novelty: Novel interpenetrating bottlebrush elastomer
Method highlight: Lowering shear modulus without increasing shear loss
Key finding: Enhancing low-loss soft ultrasonic interfaces
abstract: Ultrasound imaging relies on soft interfaces that transmit sound efficiently between a device and the body. Conventional gel couplants provide low acoustic loss but contain mobile liquid phases that can dry, flow, or leach during extended use. By contrast, mobile phase–free elastomers are more stable but generally attenuate megahertz ultrasound strongly, limiting their use as couplants. We report an interpenetrating bottlebrush elastomer molecularly designed to overcome this trade-off. A densely grafted backbone lowers the shear modulus without increasing shear loss, whereas well-packed sidechains reduce bulk compressibility, jointly suppressing acoustic attenuation in a soft elastomer. The resulting elastomer combines soft tissue–like mechanics with low-loss acoustics, providing a durable couplant for soft ultrasonic interfaces.

title: Compliant residual DAgger: Improving real-world contact-rich manipulation with human corrections
summary_zh: 研究数据聚合挑战。引入CR-DAgger，提高接触丰富操作性能。
summary_en: Studies challenges in Dataset Aggregation. Introduces CR-DAgger to enhance performance on contact-rich manipulation tasks.
insights: 创新点：CR-DAgger框架
方法亮点：合规干预接口
关键发现：性能提升64%
insights_en: Novelty: CR-DAgger framework
Method highlight: Compliant Intervention Interface
Key finding: Performance improvement by 64%
abstract: We address key challenges in Dataset Aggregation (DAgger) for real-world contact-rich manipulation: how to collect informative human correction data and how to effectively update policies with this new data. We introduce Compliant Residual DAgger (CR-DAgger), which contains two novel components: (1) a Compliant Intervention Interface that leverages compliance control, allowing humans to provide gentle, accurate delta action corrections without interrupting the ongoing robot policy execution; and (2) a Compliant Residual Policy formulation that learns from human corrections while incorporating force feedback and force control. Our system significantly enhances performance on precise contact-rich manipulation tasks using minimal correction data, improving base policy success rates by 64% on four challenging tasks (book flipping, belt assembly, cable routing, and gear insertion) while outperforming both retraining-from-scratch and finetuning approaches. Through extensive real-world experiments, we provide practical guidance for implementing effective DAgger in real-world robot learning tasks. Result videos are available at: https://compliant-residual-dagger.github.io/ .

title: MariSense: A multi-modal dataset for environmental perception in maritime autonomy
summary_zh: 本文提出MariSense数据集，用于海上自主导航的环境感知研究。数据集包含多模态数据，如毫米波雷达，以应对海上感知挑战。
summary_en: This paper presents the MariSense dataset for environmental perception research in maritime autonomy. The dataset includes multi-modal data, such as mmWave radar, to address maritime perception challenges.
insights: 创新点：提出MariSense数据集，应对海上感知挑战。
方法亮点：整合多模态数据，如毫米波雷达。
关键发现：数据集有助于海上自主导航研究。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes the MariSense dataset to address maritime perception challenges.
Method highlight: Integrates multi-modal data, such as mmWave radar.
Key finding: The dataset aids in maritime autonomy research.
abstract: Maritime autonomous navigation enables unmanned surface vehicles to perform multiple tasks and can also serve as a driver-assistance system for manned vessels, improving safety and comfort. Compared with on-road scenes, maritime perception faces unique challenges: optical sensors degrade due to reflections and sea fog, while wind and waves cause large platform motions that disrupt perception stability. Therefore, high-quality multi-modal datasets are crucial. Meanwhile, 4D millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar has been successfully applied in on-road scenes due to its all-weather, all-day, and high-resolution sensing capabilities, but its maritime characteristics and waveform design effects remain underexplored. To address these challenges, we present MariSense, a multi-modal dataset for maritime autonomy perception. MariSense is the first to introduce the concept of dynamic waveform 4D mmWave radar into maritime scenes, integrating multi-waveform radars with visible and thermal cameras, LiDAR, marine radar, Automatic Identification System (AIS), and navigation sensors, all with extrinsic calibration. The dataset covers various scenes such as anchorages and fairways under varying weather, time, and sea conditions. We establish benchmarks for object detection, tracking, and odometry, and evaluate baseline methods, highlighting the need for improved maritime perception, multi-modal fusion, and adaptive 4D mmWave radar waveform design. The dataset can be downloaded from https://github.com/ORCAUBOAT/MariSense .

title: CH2Cl2 emissions from China inferred from atmospheric observations
Engineering filamentous myosins for optical control of contractility
summary_zh: 本文研究通过工程化肌动蛋白控制收缩性。方法上，开发了一种通过蓝光控制收缩性的工具。实验表明，这种工具可以精确控制肌动蛋白的活性。
summary_en: This paper studies engineering filamentous myosins for optical control of contractility. The method develops a tool for optical control of contractility by extending the MyLOV family of gearshifting motors. Experiments show that this tool can precisely control the activity of filamentous myosins.
insights: 创新点：开发光学控制收缩性工具
方法亮点：扩展MyLOV家族齿轮换挡电机
关键发现：精确控制肌动蛋白活性
insights_en: Novelty: Development of a tool for optical control of contractility
Method highlight: Extension of the MyLOV family of gearshifting motors
