Key finding: Precise control of filamentous myosin activity
abstract: Understanding the behaviors of contractile actomyosin systems requires precise spatiotemporal control of filamentous myosin activity. Here, we develop a tool for optical control of contractility by extending the MyLOV family of gearshifting motors to create engineered filamentous myosins that change velocity in response to blue light. We characterize these minifilaments using in vitro single-molecule tracking assays, contractility assays in reconstituted actin networks, and imaging of contractile phenotypes in live cells. In vitro, gearshifting minifilaments change speed and/or direction when illuminated, and contraction rates of minifilaments in actin networks can be modulated using blue light. In cells, gearshifting minifilaments enable optical control of protrusion retraction, cortical flow, and cell migration. Finally, we develop an alternative design for minifilaments that only interact processively with actin in blue light. Engineered minifilaments could be used to dissect behaviors such as self-organization and mechanotransduction in contractile systems both in vitro and in cells and tissues. Zemsky and colleagues employ protein engineering to create filamentous myosins controlled by light. These optogenetic motors enable spatiotemporal control of contractility in vitro and in cells, providing a tool for probing contractile actomyosin systems.

title: Pico-X: a 24.9 nanowatt microcontroller for long-duration autonomous operation in flexible landing-pad sensor networks
summary_zh: 研究针对柔性着陆平台传感器网络自主运行需求，设计超低功耗微控制器Pico-X。方法上，采用硅基数字信号处理和通信技术。实验表明，Pico-X实现年尺度电池充电。
summary_en: This study designs an ultra-low-power microcontroller Pico-X for autonomous operation in flexible landing-pad sensor networks. The method employs silicon-based digital signal processing and communication technologies. Experiments show that Pico-X achieves year-scale battery charging.
insights: 创新点：设计超低功耗微控制器Pico-X
方法亮点：结合硅基数字信号处理和通信技术
关键发现：实现年尺度电池充电
insights_en: Novelty: Designing ultra-low-power microcontroller Pico-X
Method highlight: Combining silicon-based digital signal processing and communication technologies
Key finding: Achieving year-scale battery charging
abstract: Abstract The flexible landing-pad arrays in low-altitude infrastructure are embodied by ordinary items, which desirably include sensors, actuators, displays and electronic interface devices in combination with silicon-based digital signal processing and communication technologies. However, autonomous operation in the flexible landing-pad sensor networks is partly hampered due to a lack of ultra-low power level MCU system, which should be responsible for intense communication and precise control among the embodied ordinary items in the landing-pad, as well as communications among the hundreds to thousands pads in the array. At the same time, the battery recharging time is expected to be year-scale. Here, we report Pico-X, ultra-low-power specific-designed processor, which is targeted as a local computer core for flexible sensor arrays on vertiport and landing-pad surfaces. Pico-X adopts specific event-driven operation model of local sampling and decision with exception-only reporting, combined with a power-management strategy employing light forward body bias (FBB) during active operation and zero body bias (ZBB) in sleep mode. The chip is implemented based on 28-nm FDSOI technology. Measurement results demonstrate a minimum power consumption of 24.9 nW at 25 kHz, @VDD = 0.4 V, while maintaining a compact 6.1-k-gate footprint. Pico-X thus provides a programmable and scalable nanowatt-class edge intelligence platform for flexible landing-pad arrays in low-altitude infrastructure.

title: Silicon photonics provides a unified solution for all-distance optical communications
summary_zh: 研究提出统一硅光子解决方案实现全距离光通信。方法上，采用超低损耗硅氮化物外腔。实验表明，该方案实现高光谱效率和容量。
summary_en: This study proposes a unified silicon photonics solution for all-distance optical communications. The method employs an ultralow-loss silicon nitride external cavity. Experiments show that this solution achieves high spectral efficiency and capacity.
insights: 创新点：提出统一硅光子解决方案
方法亮点：采用超低损耗硅氮化物外腔
关键发现：实现高光谱效率和容量
insights_en: Novelty: Proposing a unified silicon photonics solution
Method highlight: Employing an ultralow-loss silicon nitride external cavity
Key finding: Achieving high spectral efficiency and capacity
abstract: Optical links underpin global communications from chip-to-chip interconnects to transoceanic fibre networks. Conventional architectures remain distance-dependent: long-haul systems rely on coherent transmission for high spectral efficiency and capacity, while short-reach links favour intensity modulation due to hardware complexity and power constraints. This divide impedes scalability for AI-driven intra-data-centre traffic and low-latency, flexible cloud-to-edge connectivity. Here we demonstrate a unified silicon photonic coherent solution for all-distance optical communications. By employing an ultralow-loss silicon nitride external cavity, we achieve 70 mW of direct laser output with a sub-kHz linewidth and 13.7% wall-plug efficiency. Paired with silicon photonic transceivers, this platform enables short-distance transmission without optical amplification across 256 wavelength channels, corresponding to an aggregate data rate of 81.92 Tb/s, as well as transmission exceeding 4400 km. It also supports wavelength switching and transmission re-establishment at tens-of-microseconds timescales. These results indicate the potential to simplify optical interfaces and enable flexible wavelength-routed connectivity. The authors demonstrate a silicon-photonic coherent platform using a high-power tunable laser and silicon-photonic transceivers, enabling broadband unamplified short-reach transmission, links beyond 4400 km and rapid wavelength switching.

title: Pulsed photoelectrocatalysis enables efficient urea synthesis over Cu(salen)-COF
summary_zh: 研究通过脉冲光电催化实现高效尿素合成。方法上，优化界面微环境结合脉冲电解。实验表明，该方法提高界面电荷转移。
summary_en: This study enables efficient urea synthesis through pulsed photoelectrocatalysis. The method optimizes the interfacial microenvironment combined with pulsed electrolysis. Experiments show that this method enhances interfacial charge transfer.
insights: 创新点：脉冲光电催化实现尿素合成
方法亮点：优化界面微环境结合脉冲电解
关键发现：提高界面电荷转移
insights_en: Novelty: Enabling urea synthesis through pulsed photoelectrocatalysis
Method highlight: Optimizing the interfacial microenvironment combined with pulsed electrolysis
Key finding: Enhancing interfacial charge transfer
abstract: Abstract Electrocatalytic urea synthesis from carbon dioxide and nitrate under ambient conditions offers a sustainable alternative to the energy-intensive Bosch-Meiser process. However, its efficiency is constrained by the spatiotemporal mismatch of key carbon and nitrogen intermediates at the catalyst-electrolyte interface. Herein, we address this limitation through interfacial microenvironment optimization combining ionic liquid modification of copper-salen covalent organic framework, pulsed electrolysis, and photoelectrocatalytic coupling. The ionic liquid modification enriches carbon dioxide and facilitates interfacial charge transfer, pulsed electrolysis promotes the dynamic matching of carbon and nitrogen intermediates, and photoelectrocatalytic coupling boosts interfacial electron accumulation. The integrated system achieves a urea yield rate of 69.2 mmol g cat −1 h −1 with a Faradaic efficiency of 56.7% in an H-type cell and 82.5% in a flow cell. In this work, we establish a generalizable strategy for efficient urea electrosynthesis via hierarchical interfacial control and highlight the potential of pulsed photoelectrocatalysis.

title: Entangled-to-packed crossover in nonlinear extensional rheology of entangled polymers
summary_zh: 研究揭示缠结聚合物在强拉伸流动中的转变。方法上，通过分子动力学模拟。实验表明，系统从缠结状态转变为紧密排列状态。
summary_en: This study reveals a crossover from the entangled to a packed state in the nonlinear extensional rheology of entangled polymers. The method involves molecular dynamics simulations. Experiments show that the system transitions from an entangled state to a packed configuration of aligned segments.
insights: 创新点：揭示缠结聚合物转变过程
方法亮点：分子动力学模拟研究
关键发现：系统从缠结状态转变为紧密排列状态
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the transition process in entangled polymers
Method highlight: Molecular dynamics simulations
Key finding: The system transitions from an entangled state to a packed configuration of aligned segments
abstract: The tube model, which reduces the interaction of many-chain entanglement to a single-chain picture, has enabled quantitative descriptions of the mechanical behaviors of polymeric materials and underpins applications from polymer processing to life sciences. In strong extensional flows, however, this theory systematically fails. Herein, through molecular dynamics simulations of entangled polymers, we reveal a strain-induced crossover from the entangled state to a packed state in the inter-chain configuration. Following the saturation of primitive chain stretch, convective disentanglement and chain alignment reorganize the system into a packed configuration of aligned segments. This crossover makes an explicit inter-chain contribution necessary for describing tensile stress beyond the intra-chain conformational stress, explaining the breakdown of tube-based descriptions and quantitatively capturing the mechanical response at large extensional strains. These findings clearly show how the inter-chain reorganization governs the nonlinear extensional behaviors. Entanglements among long-chain macromolecules dictate the mechanical performance of polymeric materials and are described with the tube model but the validity of this model has been questioned for nonlinear extension. Here the authors reveal the key mechanism that governs the mechanical response during extension by elucidating the evolution of entanglements using computer simulations and theoretical analysis.

title: Molecular-level control of nitrogen sites enables CO2 electro-reduction under industrially relevant conditions
summary_zh: 本文研究CO2在稀释条件下的电化学还原。通过调控Ni-N-C单原子催化剂中的吡啶氮，实现高效CO2还原。电子态分析和密度泛函理论揭示了吡啶氮形成可逆的CO2加合物。
summary_en: This paper studies CO2 electro-reduction under dilute conditions. Pyridinic nitrogen in Ni-N-C single-atom catalysts enables efficient CO2 reduction. Electronic-state analysis and density functional theory reveal the formation of a reversible CO2 adduct by pyridinic nitrogen.
insights: 创新点：通过调控吡啶氮实现高效CO2还原
方法亮点：使用电子态分析和密度泛函理论
关键发现：吡啶氮形成可逆的CO2加合物
insights_en: Novelty: Efficient CO2 reduction via pyridinic nitrogen tuning
Method highlight: Electronic-state analysis and density functional theory
Key finding: Pyridinic nitrogen forms a reversible CO2 adduct
abstract: Abstract Industrial flue gases typically contain only 3–15% CO 2 , and direct electrochemical reduction on such dilute feeds would eliminate costly upstream purification. However, mass transport limitations and competing hydrogen evolution severely restrict activity under these CO 2 -starved conditions, and the governing molecular factors remain poorly understood. Here, we demonstrate that pyridinic-nitrogen enrichment in Ni–N–C single-atom catalysts enables efficient CO 2 reduction under dilute CO 2 . By tuning the pyridinic-N to pyrrolic-N ratio in well-defined Ni–N x sites, we probe the role of local nitrogen environments in CO 2 reduction rather than the metal center alone. Electronic-state analysis and density functional theory reveal that pyridinic-N forms a reversible CO 2 adduct that enhances local CO 2 accessibility near the active Ni center through a desorption–re-adsorption relay. These findings provide molecular-level insight by identifying a neighboring motif that regulates local CO 2 availability without perturbing the intrinsic Ni–N reaction pathway, and by establishing a transferable design principle for CO 2 reduction catalysts under CO 2 -limited conditions.

title: Electrolyte-dependent physico-chemical interfacial kinetics shape degradation pathways and lifetime in lithium-ion batteries
summary_zh: 本文研究电解液条件对锂离子电池降解路径和寿命的影响。通过改变溶剂比例，观察到不同电池的寿命轨迹存在差异。
summary_en: This paper studies the impact of electrolyte conditions on degradation pathways and lifetime in lithium-ion batteries. Changing the solvent ratio leads to distinct lifetime trajectories across otherwise comparable cells.
insights: 创新点：电解液条件影响电池寿命
方法亮点：使用多层软包电池进行加速降解测试
关键发现：溶剂比例影响电池寿命轨迹
insights_en: Novelty: Electrolyte conditions affect battery lifetime
Method highlight: Multi-layer pouch cells for accelerated degradation testing
Key finding: Solvent ratio influences battery lifetime trajectories
abstract: Abstract Electrolyte-dependent lifetime variability remains a major obstacle to sustainable deployment of lithium-ion batteries, contributing to premature retirement, increased material demand and uncertainty in lifecycle assessment. However, most continuum degradation models represent the electrolyte through bulk transport, without capturing its role in interfacial degradation. Here, we use customised multi-layer pouch cells with varied ethylene carbonate:dimethyl carbonate ratio, lithium hexafluorophosphate concentration and electrolyte amount to examine how electrolyte conditions shape degradation trajectories under accelerated degradation. Within this formulation framework, changing the solvent ratio leads to distinct lifetime trajectories across otherwise comparable cells. Electrochemical diagnostics, gas analysis and post-mortem interfacial characterisation show that this divergence is associated with electrolyte-sensitive interphase growth, parasitic reactions and spatially heterogeneous surface degradation. We incorporate electrolyte-dependent transport and thermodynamic properties into a physics-based degradation model. A transport-only implementation does not reproduce the observed separation in capacity-retention trajectories. Introducing a minimal electrolyte-sensitive refinement through an effective interphase transport parameter improves agreement in the ethylene-carbonate-rich case. These results identify electrolyte-sensitive interfacial degradation as a necessary modelling dimension for reliable lifetime prediction.

title: Coordination-directed synthesis of two-dimensional metal-organic covalent organic frameworks
summary_zh: 本文研究二维金属有机共价有机框架的合成。通过构建一维配位聚合物，合成了高孔隙率的PUMC-1和PUMC-2。
summary_en: This paper studies the synthesis of two-dimensional metal-organic covalent organic frameworks. High-porosity PUMC-1 and PUMC-2 were synthesized by constructing one-dimensional coordination polymers.
insights: 创新点：二维金属有机共价有机框架的合成
方法亮点：利用三维电子衍射解析形成过程
关键发现：一维配位聚合物构建二维框架
insights_en: Novelty: Synthesis of two-dimensional metal-organic covalent organic frameworks
Method highlight: Utilizing three-dimensional electron diffraction to elucidate the formation process
Key finding: One-dimensional coordination polymers construct two-dimensional frameworks
abstract: Metal-organic covalent organic frameworks (MOCOFs) combine the advantages of covalent and metal-organic frameworks, but research remains sparse due to characterization difficulties, leaving unclear whether their formation is covalent- or coordination-directed. To date, only a few three-dimensional MOCOFs have been reported, while two-dimensional (2D) MOCOFs remain unexplored. Here, we strategically synthesize two single-crystal 2D MOCOFs with high porosity, denoted as PUMC-1 and PUMC-2. Leveraging three-dimensional electron diffraction, we are able to elucidate their formation process in detail. First, one-dimensional coordination polymers (1D CPs) are constructed from two sub-building units: tetrakis(4-aminophenyl) porphyrin and cobalt(II) trans-A₂B₂ porphyrin. Second, 1D CPs with covalent extension sites are used to construct two distinct 2D MOCOF conformations via covalent self-assembly under different conditions. Notably, the same 2D MOCOFs can also be directly obtained via one-pot synthesis with the same monomers, providing experimental evidence for a coordination-directed covalent assembly mechanism. This work not only expands the dimensionality of MOCOFs but also opens new avenues in reticular chemistry. Metal-organic covalent organic frameworks (MOCOFs) combine the advantages of covalent and metal-organic frameworks, but two-dimensional (2D) MOCOFs remain unexplored. Here, the authors synthesize two 2D MOCOFs with high porosity and elucidate their formation process in detail.

title: Through human eyes: How perception and interaction shape humanoid robot acceptance
summary_zh: 研究探讨人类视觉与交互如何影响机器人接受度。发现动态多模态交互影响信任、舒适与行为意图。
summary_en: The study explores how human perception and interaction shape humanoid robot acceptance. It finds dynamic, multimodal interactions influence trust, comfort, and behavioral intentions.
insights: 创新点：揭示人类视觉与交互对机器人接受度的影响
方法亮点：分析多模态交互对接受度的影响
关键发现：交互影响信任、舒适与行为意图
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the impact of human perception and interaction on robot acceptance
Method highlight: Analyzing the impact of multimodal interactions on acceptance
Key finding: Interactions influence trust, comfort, and behavioral intentions
abstract: Robot acceptance is shaped by dynamic, multimodal interactions that influence trust, comfort, and behavioral intentions.

title: Autane: An autonomous crane for sustained port operations
summary_zh: Autane系统用于港口RTG起重机自动化操作，实现高精度、适应性强的集装箱抓取、运输和放置。
summary_en: The Autane system is used for autonomous operations of rubber tire gantry cranes in ports, achieving high-precision, adaptable container handling, transport, and placement.
insights: 创新点：开发用于港口操作的自主起重机系统
方法亮点：实现高精度、适应性强的操作
关键发现：克服大型起重机运动精度挑战
insights_en: Novelty: Developing an autonomous crane system for port operations
Method highlight: Achieving high-precision, adaptable operations
Key finding: Overcoming challenges of large crane motion precision
abstract: Fully automated cranes are revolutionizing modern port operations by addressing labor shortages, improving precision, and enhancing safety. Toward this goal, we present the Autane (autonomous crane) system specifically developed for rubber tire gantry (RTG) cranes handling standardized containers in port yards, enabling autonomous safety-critical container grabbing, transport, and placement with high accuracy, adaptability, and efficiency. Autane overcomes the challenges of safe motion of large-scale cranes with centimeter-level precision requirements, providing long-distance high-precision perception. It uses multisensor fusion, real-time obstacle detection, and simultaneous localization and mapping to perceive the environment, identify container features, and dynamically adjust trajectories. By tightly coupling perception, planning, control, and operation and maintenance, Autane achieves safe and precise alignment, seamless interaction with transport vehicles, and robust execution of long-distance handling tasks. Deployed in multiple ports, Autane shows full-day operation and has autonomously handled more than 2 million 20-foot equivalent units. This work highlights the potential of fully autonomous RTG cranes to enable sustained, resilient, and low-intervention port automation.

title: Heavy metal acrobatics: Learning dynamic control for skid-steer loaders
summary_zh: 研究通过强化学习自动化重型机械操作，模拟实验成功实现极限操作。
summary_en: The study automates heavy machinery operations through reinforcement learning, successfully achieving extreme maneuvers in simulation experiments.
insights: 创新点：应用强化学习自动化重型机械操作
方法亮点：模拟实验实现极限操作
关键发现：强化学习在模拟中成功应用
insights_en: Novelty: Applying reinforcement learning to automate heavy machinery operations
Method highlight: Achieving extreme maneuvers in simulation experiments
Key finding: Successful application of reinforcement learning in simulation
abstract: Automation of heavy machinery offers the opportunity to improve productivity in mechanized industries such as construction, mining, and material handling. Yet, automation of such machines is challenged by their complex dynamics, in part because of hydraulic actuation that involves fluids, flexible elements, and nonlinear delays. A concomitant challenge is the size and weight of these machines, which can make experiments on the physical systems exceedingly dangerous. Here, we show that reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation, followed by transfer of the learned policies from simulation to reality, can successfully automate acrobatic maneuvers that push a heavy construction machine to the limits of its actuation and have only previously been accomplished by a small number of elite human operators in official world-record performances. We trained policies that perform autonomous acrobatic maneuvers on a John Deere 332G, an operational 5-tonne skid-steer loader. The policies can autonomously swing the machine up onto two wheels and, while balancing on two wheels, drive over rough terrain, trace out specified trajectories, spin around, and swing the bucket back and forth before landing it safely back onto four wheels. This work demonstrates that RL and sim-to-real transfer enable dynamic autonomous control of heavy machinery, directly contributing to greater automation in heavy equipment sectors.

title: Strain-based Cosserat dynamic control of soft manipulator
summary_zh: 提出基于应变的Cosserat动态模型，用于软体机器人的建模和控制。分析控制输入有界性和基于电缆长度的控制。
summary_en: This paper proposes a strain-based Cosserat dynamic model for the modeling and control of soft manipulators. Issues such as control input boundedness and cable length-based control are analyzed.
insights: 创新点：提出基于应变的Cosserat动态模型
方法亮点：分析控制输入有界性
关键发现：基于电缆长度的控制
insights_en: Novelty: Proposing a strain-based Cosserat dynamic model
Method highlight: Analyzing control input boundedness
Key finding: Cable length-based control
abstract: Accurate control of soft manipulators is challenging due to the complexity of their infinite-dimensional nonlinear dynamics. The Cosserat rod theory provides a robust framework for modeling the nonlinear deformation behaviors of soft robots. In this paper, a comprehensive insight into the strain-based Cosserat dynamic models is presented to facilitate the model-based controller design for slender soft robots. Based on the strain-based Cosserat dynamics, a general estimation-based dynamic control framework for the soft manipulator is proposed for the first time, and its corresponding implementation issues, such as control input boundedness and cable length-based control, are analyzed. The tracking performance of these controllers is evaluated through numerical simulations on a soft manipulator. Beyond the simulations, and thanks to the design and implementation of finite-time state estimator, experiments are carried out on a real soft cable-driven prototype to further validate the tracking performance of the proposed controllers. Comparative experimental results indicate that the estimation-based dynamic controllers enable accurate and fast tracking of the desired references for the slender soft prototype.

title: Hadean mantle depletion and 3.95-Gyr subduction implied by North China rocks
summary_zh: 研究发现，华北克拉通东部3.95亿年古老岩石表明，地球早期地壳形成和板块构造开始时间可能比之前认为的更早。这些岩石来自一个贫化地幔源区，与加拿大阿卡斯塔片麻岩的起源不同。
summary_en: The study reveals that ancient rocks in the eastern Hebei Craton, North China, suggest that the formation of Earth's first continental crust and the start of plate tectonics may have occurred earlier than previously thought. These rocks originate from a depleted mantle source, distinct from the origin of the ca. 4.0 Ga Acasta rocks.
insights: 创新点：发现古老岩石揭示地壳形成时间
方法亮点：分析古老岩石的δ18O和εHf(t)值
关键发现：地壳形成和板块构造开始时间可能更早
insights_en: Novelty: Ancient rocks reveal crust formation time
Method highlight: Analysis of δ18O and εHf(t) values in ancient rocks
Key finding: Earth's crust formation and plate tectonics may have started earlier
abstract: Abstract The scarcity of terrestrial rocks older than 3.9 billion years (Ga) has hindered our understanding of Earth’s early evolution, fueling persistent debates on how and when the first continental crust formed and plate tectonics started. Currently, the only unequivocally documented >3.9 Ga rocks are from the Acasta Gneiss Complex, Canada 1–3. Here we report a newly discovered 3.95 Ga trondhjemitic gneiss from eastern Hebei, North China Craton, where 3.95 Ga magmatic zircon records elevated δ18O values (average +6.77 ± 0.23‰) and positive εHf(t) (weighted mean +1.45 ± 0.27), indicating a low-temperature altered basaltic source that originated from a Hadean depleted mantle. In contrast to the low-pressure origin inferred for the ca. 4.0 Ga Acasta rocks 2, the 3.95 Ga trondhjemitic gneiss reported here exhibits geochemical signatures attributed to a high-pressure origin 4. Thermodynamic and trace element modelling demonstrates that its parental magma formed via low degree (8–16%) melting of basaltic crust at >1.6 GPa and 740–820 ℃, suggesting rapid burial of (near-)surface‑altered oceanic crust to mantle depths along a cool thermal gradient. We propose that this rapid burial was most likely achieved through a transient subduction event.

title: When Hedging Hides Heterogeneity: A Measurement and Identification Framework for Uncertainty in Large Language Models
summary_zh: 本文提出测量和识别大语言模型不确定性的框架，区分四种潜在驱动因素。分析表明，输出的一致性掩盖了异质性。
summary_en: This paper proposes a framework for measuring and identifying uncertainty in large language models, distinguishing four latent drivers. Analysis shows that the consistency of output conceals heterogeneity.
insights: 创新点：区分大语言模型的不确定性驱动因素
方法亮点：提出测量和识别框架
关键发现：输出的一致性掩盖了异质性
insights_en: Novelty: Distinguishing uncertainty drivers in large language models
Method highlight: Proposing a measurement and identification framework
Key finding: Output consistency conceals heterogeneity
abstract: Large language models routinely hedge on contested questions, but the surface uniformity of such hedging conceals a heterogeneous mixture of underlying latent drivers. We distinguish four latent drivers: epistemic uncertainty, hermeneutic openness, alignment-induced policy effects (which can suppress or amplify evaluative stance), and cross-context interpretive divergence. We argue that verbalised output is best understood as a measurement-and-identification problem in which these heterogeneous latent drivers of uncertainty and stance are compressed into a single output channel by a noninjective verbalisation map: similar hedging or balancing language may reflect genuine uncertainty or instead policy and contextual effects, and a user cannot reliably distinguish these drivers from a single output. We formalise this compression, characterise the decision-theoretic regret of conflating drivers whose appropriate downstream interventions differ, and observe that this regret does not vanish under additional factual evidence when the dominant driver is non-epistemic. Empirical claims are anchored in a pre-specified replication study. We then introduce four families of identifying probes, namely factual-evidence augmentation, counterfactual rephrasing, standpoint-conditioned elicitation, and cross-lingual consistency, which provide directional identification of the dominant latent driver of an observed hedge. We close with implications for professional practice in journalism, policy analysis, and comparative research; design principles for uncertainty-disclosure interfaces; and a benchmark proposal for driver-stratified evaluation of LLM uncertainty.

title: Autonomous navigation of multiple reconfigurable ferrofluid droplet robots in complex environments
summary_zh: 本文研究多变形铁流体液滴机器人自主导航问题。方法上，提出动态路径规划与自适应运动控制框架。实验表明，机器人能通过复杂环境。
summary_en: This paper studies autonomous navigation for multiple reconfigurable ferrofluid droplet robots. The method proposes a dynamic path planning and adaptive motion control framework. Experiments show the robots can navigate through complex environments.
insights: 创新点：动态路径规划与自适应运动控制框架
方法亮点：分布式路径规划算法
关键发现：机器人能自主通过复杂环境
insights_en: Novelty: Dynamic path planning and adaptive motion control framework
Method highlight: Distributed path planning algorithm
Key finding: Robots can autonomously navigate complex environments
abstract: Ferrofluid-based soft robots with extreme deformability have emerged as promising manipulation tools for diverse biomedical applications. Their unique properties to navigate irregular terrains and access otherwise unreachable regions within confined spaces have enabled new opportunities in targeted drug delivery, microfluidic logistics, and lab/organ on-a-chip. However, achieving dynamic motion planning and intelligent behavior for multiple reconfigurable ferrofluid droplet robots (FDRs) is still one of the major challenges yet to be solved. In this paper, we develop a novel framework that integrates dynamic path planning with adaptive motion control for teams of deformable FDRs to autonomously navigate through diverse scenarios involving moving obstacles. We first introduce a distributed magnetic field actuation platform capable of generating a series of local magnetic field sources to enable discrete locomotion and extreme deformation of multiple FDRs. Subsequently, an incremental version of the conflict-based search (CBS) algorithm, called the ICBS, is presented, which aims at finding conflict-free paths for more than one agent (i.e., FDR) and updating the plan according to changes in the environment or missions. To quantitatively describe different behaviors of FDRs and realize adaptive morphology transition, an image-guided motion-deformation controller combined with a finite state machine (FSM) is then designed. The physical and actuation constraints associated with the system are also considered for FDRs in close proximity so that they can smoothly traverse the planned waypoints in the form of localized step-by-step. Finally, extensive simulations and experiments are performed under different conditions to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The results demonstrate that the deployed FDRs are capable of fully automated navigation with adaptive morphology transitions (stretching, splitting, and merging) in various complex environments.

title: Flexible rubber blades for tidal turbines
summary_zh: 本文研究柔性橡胶叶片在潮汐涡轮机中的应用。方法上，提出被动式叶片设计。实验表明，叶片性能与主动式叶片相当。
summary_en: This paper studies the application of flexible rubber blades in tidal turbines. The method proposes a passive blade design. Experiments show the blades achieve equivalent performance to active blades.
insights: 创新点：柔性橡胶叶片设计
方法亮点：被动式叶片设计
关键发现：叶片性能相当
insights_en: Novelty: Design of flexible rubber blades
Method highlight: Passive blade design
Key finding: Equivalent blade performance
abstract: Abstract The global transition towards sustainable energy systems has identified tidal power as a uniquely predictable and substantial renewable energy resource 1 . However, the highly unsteady sea environment subjects turbines to severe hydrodynamic loads, greatly increasing capital and maintenance costs 2,3 . Large-scale state-of-the-art turbines at present rely on complex, expensive active pitch systems to mitigate these fluctuations. Here we present a reliable, passive alternative: flexible rubber blades featuring chordwise trailing-edge deformation. We experimentally demonstrate that these flexible blades achieve an equivalent total energy yield over simulated tidal cycles compared with rigid blades with active pitch control, while mitigating high-frequency fatigue-inducing load fluctuations by up to one-third. This passive load regulation arises from aeroelastic deformation that flattens blade camber under load, enabling structural robustness without added mechanical complexity. These findings suggest that chordwise-flexible blades can enhance the durability and performance of tidal turbines, offering a promising pathway towards more reliable and cost-effective tidal energy generation.

title: Facet-dependent anion adsorption for electrolyte-Cu interfacial stability in initially anode-free Li-metal batteries
summary_zh: 研究初期无阳极锂金属电池界面稳定性，揭示电解质成分吸附机制。发现有机溶剂吸附强于锂盐，形成溶剂主导界面层。
summary_en: This study investigates the interface stability in initially anode-free Li-metal batteries, revealing the mechanism of anion adsorption by electrolyte components. It is found that organic solvents adsorb more strongly than Li-salt compounds, forming a solvent-dominated interfacial layer.
insights: 创新点：揭示电解质成分吸附机制
方法亮点：采用原位表征技术
关键发现：有机溶剂吸附强于锂盐
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the mechanism of anion adsorption by electrolyte components
Method highlight: Using in-situ characterization techniques
Key finding: Organic solvents adsorb more strongly than Li-salt compounds
abstract: Initially anode-free Li-metal batteries, in which Li-metal is constructed in-situ during charging, enable increased energy density. However, interfacial degradation reactions between the electrolyte and lithiophobic Cu prevent stable solid electrolyte interphase formation on the negative electrode. Here, we elucidate a time-evolving interfacial mechanism in which adsorption of electrolyte components contributes to initial interfacial layer formation and solid electrolyte interphase stability. Most organic solvents adsorb more strongly than Li-salt compounds on Cu through van der Waals dispersion interactions. This preferential adsorption produces a solvent-dominated interfacial layer that undergoes rapid compositional reconstruction during Cu oxide reduction upon initial charging. In contrast, lithium tetrafluoroborate possesses a tetrahedral anion with isotropic charge distribution that binds strongly to the Cu (111)/(100) surfaces and native Cu oxides, producing a tetrafluoroborate-driven interfacial layer that electronically passivates the Cu interface and promotes homogeneous Li nucleation. Consequently, lithium tetrafluoroborate-containing cells achieve 62% capacity retention after 300 cycles at an areal capacity of 4.1 mAh cm−2 and electrolyte conditions of 1.5 g Ah−1 and 4 μL cm−2, establishing a mechanistic basis for adsorption-driven interfacial design in initially anode-free Li-metal batteries. Initially anode-free lithium-metal batteries are limited by unstable interfacial reactions at Cu current collectors. Here, authors show that preferential anion adsorption can stabilize the copper interface and improve long-term cycling.

title: Knowledge-guided machine learning deciphers spatiotemporal dynamics in chemical reactor systems
summary_zh: 本研究提出一种将物理知识嵌入机器学习框架的方法，以解析化学反应器系统中的时空动态。方法上，结合焦炭积累裂化反应器进行验证。实验表明，该方法显著提高预测性能。
summary_en: This study presents a method that embeds physical knowledge into a machine learning framework to decipher spatiotemporal dynamics in chemical reactor systems. The method is validated using a coke-accumulating cracking reactor. Experiments show that this approach significantly enhances predictive performance.
insights: 创新点：将物理知识嵌入机器学习框架。
方法亮点：结合焦炭积累裂化反应器进行验证。
关键发现：显著提高预测性能。
insights_en: Novelty: Embeds physical knowledge into a machine learning framework.
Method highlight: Validates using a coke-accumulating cracking reactor.
Key finding: Significantly enhances predictive performance.
abstract: Characterizing the spatiotemporal dynamics of complex chemical reactors, especially localized engineering-critical points or regions, remains challenging in process engineering. Although data-driven methods offer computational advantages, the incorporation of domain-specific physical knowledge can further enhance their predictive performance. Here, we present a physics-informed machine learning framework that systematically embeds coking mechanisms and heat transfer principles into neural network architecture and training constraints. Using a coke-accumulating cracking reactor as a prototypical case, the proposed approach reproduces the spatiotemporal distributions of key operational parameters obtained from conventional simulations with high fidelity and achieves a 105-fold computational acceleration. Crucially, the incorporation of mechanistic knowledge enhances prediction fidelity for critical safety indicators, particularly the maximum external wall temperature (error < 0.5%), enabling precise identification of optimal decoking intervals. This paradigm bridges data efficiency with domain-informed modeling, providing a useful reference for developing real-time monitoring and optimization models for complex industrial systems. A physics-informed neural network embeds coking and heat transfer knowledge via an output integration layer and region-weighted loss to predict reactor spatiotemporal fields; it matches conventional simulation results, improves peak wall temperature accuracy, and runs about five orders of magnitude faster than conventional simulations.

title: Transforming spinel LiMn2O4 into a Na-layered cathode
summary_zh: 研究将尖晶石LiMn2O4转化为钠离子正极。通过电化学钠化驱动Mn离子迁移，形成层状/尖晶石异质结构。
summary_en: This study transforms spinel LiMn2O4 into a sodium-ion cathode. Electrochemical sodiation drives Mn-ion migration, creating a layered/spinel heterostructure.
insights: 创新点：将尖晶石LiMn2O4转化为钠离子正极
方法亮点：电化学钠化驱动Mn离子迁移
关键发现：形成层状/尖晶石异质结构
insights_en: Novelty: Transforming spinel LiMn2O4 into a sodium-ion cathode
Method highlight: Electrochemical sodiation driving Mn-ion migration
Key finding: Formation of layered/spinel heterostructure
abstract: Abstract The positive electrode structures of practical sodium-ion batteries are generally confined to polyanionic or layered transition metal oxide frameworks, where the trade-off between specific energy and structural stability limits their application. As a well-established positive electrode structure in lithium-ion batteries, the spinel framework has abundant storage sites for alkali metal ions, but it has received less attention for sodium-ion batteries. Here we show that spinel LiMn 2 O 4 can be transformed into a sodium-ion positive electrode. Electrochemical sodiation drives Mn-ion migration along an octahedral–tetrahedral–octahedral pathway, creating a layered/spinel heterostructure for further sodium storage. Moreover, residual spinel domains inhibit the strain and structural degradation within the layered structure. Consequently, a 26650 cylindrical cell using a LiMn 2 O 4 -derived sodium-ion positive electrode achieves a capacity of 3.85 Ah and retains 95.7% capacity after 900 cycles (1.925 A). This work demonstrates that spinel LiMn 2 O 4 can serve as a viable positive electrode for sodium-ion batteries, and that electrochemical transformation is a feasible approach for creating positive electrode frameworks.

title: Upcycling of polyolefin and polyester mixtures via a single-atom alloy
summary_zh: 研究通过单原子合金实现聚烯烃和聚酯混合物的升级回收。设计催化剂，实现混合塑料到燃料范围烃类的一步转化。
summary_en: This study achieves upcycling of polyolefin and polyester mixtures via a single-atom alloy. A catalyst is designed for one-pot conversion of mixed plastics into fuel-range hydrocarbons.
insights: 创新点：单原子合金实现混合塑料的升级回收
方法亮点：设计催化剂实现一步转化
关键发现：混合塑料到燃料范围烃类的高转化率
insights_en: Novelty: Single-atom alloy for upcycling mixed plastics
Method highlight: Catalyst design for one-pot conversion
Key finding: High conversion rate of mixed plastics into fuel-range hydrocarbons
abstract: Upcycling of mixed plastic waste is challenging due to the complex compositions and high sorting costs, lacking robust catalysts for simultaneous conversion of polyolefins and polyesters. Herein, guided by machine learning, we design a Ru1Cu/CeO2-GR single-atom alloy catalyst that enables one-pot hydrogenolysis of mixed plastics into fuel-range hydrocarbons. Ru single atoms anchored on Cu nanoparticles lower C–C bond cleavage barriers, while Cu suppresses benzene ring overhydrogenation. Under mild conditions (280 °C, 30 bar H2), the catalyst delivers ~75% liquid yield (C5–C22) with 59.5%–62.7% C8–C16 fraction and ~15% aromatic products yield from five-component mixed plastics. Life cycle and techno-economic analyses confirm that this direct upcycling route outperforms traditional sorted recycling with lower environmental impacts and higher economic benefits. This work provides a sustainable and economically viable strategy for mixed plastic waste valorization. Mixed plastic waste is difficult to recycle because different polymers require separate processing. This study develops a catalyst that converts mixed plastics directly into fuel-range hydrocarbons with high liquid yield.

title: Superionicity and premelting of iron-rich (Fe,Mg)O at Earth’s core-mantle boundary
summary_zh: 研究地球核心-地幔边界铁镁氧化物超离子性和预熔化现象。实验揭示其在高温下表现出超离子性和晶界预熔化。这些现象导致弹性软化、元素传输增强和超低粘度。
summary_en: This study investigates the superionicity and premelting of iron-rich (Fe,Mg)O at Earth's core-mantle boundary. Experiments reveal its superionic onset and grain-boundary premelting at high temperatures, leading to elastic softening, enhanced elemental transport, and ultra-low viscosity.
insights: 创新点：发现铁镁氧化物在高温下表现出超离子性和预熔化现象。
方法亮点：采用实验研究地球内部物质行为。
关键发现：超离子性和预熔化现象对地球内部物质传输有重要影响。
insights_en: Novelty: Identified superionicity and premelting in iron-rich (Fe,Mg)O at high temperatures.
Method highlight: Employed experimental methods to study the behavior of Earth's internal materials.
Key finding: Superionicity and premelting significantly affect material transport in the Earth's interior.
abstract: Abstract Core-mantle interactions are essential for understanding Earth’s interior dynamics and evolution. Experimental studies reveal that core-mantle reactions produce iron-rich (Fe,Mg)O (periclase‑wüstite solid solution). Here we show that Fe-rich (Fe,Mg)O exhibits pronounced superionic-onset and grain-boundary premelting behavior above ~0.9 T m ( T m : melting temperature). These effects are significant in (Fe x Mg 1-x )O (x > 0.8) under core-mantle boundary (CMB) conditions, causing elastic softening, enhanced elemental transport, and ultra-low viscosity. Enhanced diffusion may facilitate core-mantle reactions and the accumulation of Fe-rich material near the CMB, potentially contributing to a dense basal assemblage. Under mantle flow and/or thermal buoyancy, the low viscosity of connected Fe-rich (Fe,Mg)O could favor deformation and redistribution toward shallower depths. This process may contribute to the formation and evolution of some ultra-low velocity zones (ULVZs). The proposed scenario is consistent with the layered structures and inferred low viscosity of some ULVZs and suggests a potential role for Fe-rich (Fe,Mg)O in core-mantle material exchange and heat transfer.

title: Dual-functional-unit modulation enables superior energy storage in high-entropy relaxor ferroelectrics
summary_zh: 通过双功能单元调制策略提高高熵弛豫铁电体的储能性能。通过配置熵工程和微观结构优化，实现局部极化配置和氧八面体倾斜配置的定制。
summary_en: This study enhances energy storage performance in high-entropy relaxor ferroelectrics through dual-functional-unit modulation. Configuration entropy engineering combined with microstructural optimization tailor local polarization configurations and oxygen octahedral tilt configurations.
insights: 创新点：提出双功能单元调制策略。
方法亮点：采用配置熵工程和微观结构优化。
关键发现：实现局部极化配置和氧八面体倾斜配置的定制。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed a dual-functional-unit modulation strategy.
Method highlight: Employed configuration entropy engineering and microstructural optimization.
Key finding: Achieved customization of local polarization configurations and oxygen octahedral tilt configurations.
abstract: High-performance dielectric capacitors are indispensable for next-generation pulsed power systems. However, simultaneously achieving high recoverable energy density and efficiency remains challenging because of the intrinsic trade-off between polarization and breakdown strength. Here, we develop a dual-functional-unit modulation strategy to overcome this limitation in Bi 0.47 Na 0.47 Ba 0.06 TiO 3 -based ceramics through configurational-entropy engineering combined with microstructural optimization. Specifically, configurational entropy simultaneously tailors two key local functional units, namely local polarization configurations and oxygen octahedral tilt configurations. Multicomponent substitution at the A site (Ba 2+ ) and B site (Zn 2+ /Nb 5+ ) induces fragmented heterogeneous polarization configurations together with weakened and disordered oxygen octahedral tilt, enabling strong field-induced polarization, highly reversible polarization responses, and enhanced intrinsic breakdown strength. Combined with grain refinement and improved densification achieved by high-energy ball milling, which further enhances electrical homogeneity and suppresses interfacial polarization, the optimized ceramic exhibits a breakdown strength of 94 kV mm −1 , a large recoverable energy density of 16.19 J cm −3 and a high efficiency of 91.3%. This work establishes dual-functional-unit modulation as an effective design principle for high-entropy relaxor ferroelectrics and provides a general framework for overcoming the polarization-breakdown trade-off in dielectric energy storage materials.

title: Encoding atomic-layer thickness via spin-dependent optical differentiation
summary_zh: 提出一种基于自旋依赖性光学区分的方法，将原子层厚度编码到可直接观察的边缘特征中。通过工程光学传输函数，实现各向异性和各向同性区分。
summary_en: This study introduces a spin-dependent optical differentiation approach that encodes atomic-layer thickness into directly observable edge features. By engineering the optical transfer function at planar interfaces, anisotropic and isotropic differentiation regimes are achieved.
insights: 创新点：提出自旋依赖性光学区分方法。
方法亮点：实现原子层厚度到边缘特征的编码。
关键发现：各向异性和各向同性区分得以实现。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed a spin-dependent optical differentiation approach.
Method highlight: Achieved encoding of atomic-layer thickness into edge features.
Key finding: Anisotropic and isotropic differentiation regimes are realized.
abstract: Abstract Two-dimensional materials exhibit pronounced layer-dependent properties, making accurate determination of atomic-layer thickness essential. Existing characterization techniques typically rely on spectroscopic signatures or scanning probes, which require complex instrumentation and often lack direct real-space interpretability. Here we introduce a spin-dependent optical differentiation approach that encodes thickness into directly observable edge features. By engineering the optical transfer function at planar interfaces, we access anisotropic and isotropic differentiation regimes governed by the spin Hall effect of light. In the anisotropic regime, the layer number is continuously encoded in the orientation of edge features. In the isotropic regime, a morphology-based transition, from disk to ring, provides a discrete and robust signature for layer identification. We experimentally demonstrate layer-resolved imaging in graphene, MoS 2 , and WSe 2 . Our results establish spin-dependent optical differentiation as a simple and versatile platform for translating atomic-scale variations into directly accessible optical features, enabling rapid and in situ characterization of two-dimensional materials.

title: Low-temperature operation of Ag—C based anodeless all-solid-state pouch cells
summary_zh: 研究银碳基无正极全固态软包电池在低温下的运行机制。发现锂银合金化动力学受温度影响，低温下合金化动力学受抑制，导致锂传输缓慢。
summary_en: This study investigates the low-temperature operation mechanism of Ag-C based anodeless all-solid-state pouch cells. It finds that lithium-silver alloying dynamics are highly temperature-dependent, with kinetic suppression at low temperatures leading to slow lithium transport.
insights: 创新点：发现锂银合金化动力学受温度影响。
方法亮点：采用原位X射线吸收光谱等技术。
关键发现：低温下合金化动力学受抑制。
insights_en: Novelty: Identified the temperature dependence of lithium-silver alloying dynamics.
Method highlight: Employed in situ X-ray absorption spectroscopy and other techniques.
Key finding: Kinetic suppression of alloying dynamics at low temperatures.
abstract: Abstract Anodeless all-solid-state batteries with Ag-C interlayers offer high energy density and long cycle life, yet their operation in cold environments remains limited by poorly understood failure mechanisms. Using operando X-ray absorption spectroscopy, cryogenic-cross-section electron microscopy, and X-ray diffraction, we discover that Li-Ag alloying dynamics are highly temperature-dependent: rapid at 45 °C but kinetically suppressed at 5 °C. At low temperatures, suppressed alloying leads to sluggish lithium transport, internal lithium extrusion, interlayer delamination, and rapid capacity decay. We demonstrate that a brief initial charge at 45 °C permanently activates the interlayer via Li-Ag alloy formation, enabling efficient Li transport even at 5 °C. Full pouch cells following this activation protocol retain 87% of their initial capacity after 250 completed cycles following one formation cycle at 5 °C. After 250 cycles at 5 °C, AAP-treated cells delivered approximately three times the discharge capacity of cells cycled with the fixed-temperature protocol. Such in situ electrochemical alloy activation offers a practical and scalable approach to extend anodeless all-solid-state battery performance to sub-ambient temperatures without material redesign.

title: Bridging vision-language reasoning and learned control for legged navigation in the wild
summary_zh: ROAM结合视觉-语言模型和强化学习，实现复杂环境中的腿部导航。
summary_en: ROAM combines a vision-language model with reinforcement learning for legged navigation in complex environments.
insights: 创新点：结合视觉-语言模型和强化学习
方法亮点：实现复杂环境中的导航
关键发现：提升机器人自主导航能力
insights_en: Novelty: Combines vision-language model and reinforcement learning
Method highlight: Achieves navigation in complex environments
Key finding: Enhances robotic autonomous navigation capabilities
abstract: Autonomous navigation in diverse real-world environments remains one of the greatest challenges in robotics. It demands both robust low-level motion control to handle diverse terrain and high-level reasoning to interpret environmental cues. We present ROAM (Robust Open-world Autonomous Mobility), a system that enables legged robots to perform kilometer-scale navigation in complex alpine and urban settings. ROAM combines the world knowledge of a vision-language model (VLM), pretrained on internet-scale data, with robust locomotion and local planning policies learned in simulation via reinforcement learning (RL). The VLM provides common-sense reasoning and semantic interpretation of the scene, assessing risks, interpreting signs, and producing semantic labels with associated navigation costs. An open-vocabulary segmentation module converts these labels into a dense, real-time risk map, which conditions two pretrained RL policies responsible for agile locomotion and local navigation: effectively coupling high-level VLM reasoning with low-level physical control. Real-world experiments showed the system’s ability to autonomously navigate a wide range of complex real-world environments. The robot completed kilometer-long hikes with minimal intervention, interpreted signs to avoid danger, and evaluated its environment to identify safe areas on which to step. This work represents a step toward the reliable deployment of systems in unstructured environments. However, it also underscores the challenges that remain in VLM reliability and spatial reasoning, indicating that foundational models are a crucial component but not yet a complete solution for navigation in the wild.

title: Printing powerful soft robots on a desktop
summary_zh: 本文提出3D打印高功率气动架构，实现桌面级软机器人。
summary_en: This paper proposes a 3D-printed high-power pneumatic architecture for desktop-level soft robots.
insights: 创新点：3D打印高功率气动架构
方法亮点：桌面级软机器人制造
关键发现：提高软机器人实用性
insights_en: Novelty: 3D printing high-power pneumatic architecture
Method highlight: Desktop-level soft robot fabrication
Key finding: Improves practicality of soft robots
abstract: Soft robots can achieve complex behaviors with simple control strategies. One promising approach is to embed fluidic control circuits directly into the structure of a soft robot without electronics. Automated additive manufacturing offers a route to consistently fabricate such integrated robotic systems without labor-intensive manual assembly. However, previous soft robots fabricated using this approach relied on control circuits that operated at low power, limiting their practical utility. Here, we present a 3D-printed high-power pneumatic architecture for driving soft robots. At its core is a double-expansion pneumatic oscillator inspired by the compound steam engine that converts a constant high-pressure gas input into four-phase pressure signals at high frequency. We demonstrate its use in a monolithically 3D-printed hexapod running robot capable of reaching a top speed of 4.72 meters per second with an estimated mechanical power output of 169 watts, exhibiting high-speed locomotion in a fully soft robotic system. The robot traversed rough outdoor terrain and aquatic environments and could also be operated with a liquid working medium, tap water, representing a key advance toward digitally fabricated soft robots with high performance for accomplishing real-world tasks.

title: Design, fabrication and control of A multifunctional tactile gripper for human-like grasping and pinching
summary_zh: 本文设计了一种多功能触觉抓取器，支持类似人类的抓握和捏合动作。通过伺服电机和生物力学触觉传感器实现。
summary_en: This paper presents a novel multifunctional tactile gripper that supports human-like grasping and pinching actions. It is driven by a servo motor and equipped with a biomimetic tactile sensor.
insights: 创新点：多功能触觉抓取器设计
方法亮点：伺服电机和生物力学触觉传感器应用
关键发现：实现类似人类的抓握和捏合动作
insights_en: Novelty: Design of a multifunctional tactile gripper
Method highlight: Application of servo motor and biomimetic tactile sensor
Key finding: Achieving human-like grasping and pinching actions
abstract: This paper presents a novel two-claw robotic gripper with haptic feedback that supports diverse grasping modes inspired by human taxonomy, including precision grasps, power grasps, and flip-and-pinch actions, requiring different postures, force distributions, and impedance characteristics. The gripper is driven by a servo motor with multiple springs, enabling an autonomous transition from a four-bar linkage for position control to a five-bar mechanism for impedance control upon object contact. In addition, a biomimetic tactile sensor, TacSlim, is developed to enhance haptic feedback during grasping of objects of varying sizes. The sensor features a wedge-shaped profile, fingerprints, and a nail-like structure. Its geometry is jointly optimized with the gripper’s structural parameters to ensure that the surface normal of TacSlim aligns with the contact regions across different object postures. Furthermore, we develop an integrated visual–tactile perception, action planning, and control framework, comprising modules for vision-based grasp mode and posture prediction, tactile sensing, arm–gripper coordination, and iterative learning-based variable impedance control to handle disturbances and uncertainties. These modules collectively enable fully autonomous execution of multifunctional grasping tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed gripper successfully grasps objects ranging from 2 mm to 64 mm in size and from 10 g to 4 kg in weight, achieving high detection accuracy and consistently high success rates across a wide variety of object shapes and conditions.

title: Hyperelastic microfibers as bioinspired proprioceptive artificial muscles
summary_zh: 研究提出利用超弹性微纤维作为生物启发的本体感觉人工肌肉。实验表明，该结构具有形状分叉特性。
summary_en: This study proposes using hyperelastic microfibers as bio-inspired proprioceptive artificial muscles. Experiments show shape bifurcation characteristics of the structure.
insights: 创新点：超弹性微纤维作为本体感觉人工肌肉
方法亮点：结合超弹性流体通道和刚性光学核心
关键发现：形状分叉特性
insights_en: Novelty: Hyperelastic microfibers as proprioceptive artificial muscles
Method highlight: Combining hyperelastic fluid channels with a rigid optical core
Key finding: Shape bifurcation characteristics
abstract: Skeletal muscles combine forceful contraction with built-in sensing of their own length and movement, known as proprioception. Reproducing this combination in soft artificial muscles remains difficult, because added sensors often reduce actuation performance, complicate fabrication or limit miniaturization. In natural muscle, specialized sensory fibers are embedded alongside, and mechanically coupled to, the force-generating fibers. Inspired by this arrangement, we pair a hyperelastic, highly stretchable fluid channel with a stiffer, off-center optical core inside a single thin fiber. When liquid is pumped in, the channel wall undergoes a shape bifurcation: a localized bulge forms and propagates along the fiber. Because the core resists stretching, the bulge bends the fiber into a contracting coil, while the core also reports the fiber’s shape through the light it transmits. Here we show that such fibers, produced continuously by a scalable drawing process, act as artificial muscles that sense their own contraction and stretching, supporting self-monitoring movement in soft robots.

title: SALT: Boston Dynamics Spot Autowalk Long-Term Mapping Dataset
summary_zh: SALT数据集包含近两年内Boston Dynamics Spot机器人在不同场景下的多次行走数据。
summary_en: The SALT dataset contains multiple traversals of the Boston Dynamics Spot robot across different scenarios over nearly two years.
insights: 创新点：SALT数据集包含多种场景下的行走数据
方法亮点：提供多种数据格式
关键发现：数据覆盖近两年时间
insights_en: Novelty: The SALT dataset includes walking data across various scenarios
Method highlight: Provides multiple data formats
Key finding: Data covers nearly two years
abstract: The Spot Autowalk Long-Term (SALT) Dataset was collected by performing repeated Autowalks with a Boston Dynamics Spot robot across three different scenarios, including both indoor and outdoor environments. The main contribution is 217 traversals of an outdoor Autowalk around the Ontario Tech University campus over a 16 month period. The recorded data includes point clouds, local elevation and occupancy grids, dynamic object and staircase detection, odometry data, joint states, and battery conditions. In total, the dataset contains 286 traversals and 193 km of walking over a period of nearly 2 years. The data is presented in multiple formats for ease of use, including: native format, a human-readable format, a KITTI Odometry format including pseudo ground truth poses, and an MCAP format for use with ROS2. This dataset aims to enable researchers to develop new algorithms for long-term mapping applications. The SALT dataset can be found here https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20670050

title: Modeling the frictional contact of continuum robots with environments through linear complementarity problem
summary_zh: 研究提出基于线性互补问题的连续体机器人与环境摩擦接触模型。该模型预测静态和滑动摩擦以及滞后行为。
summary_en: This study proposes a frictional contact model between continuum robots and environments based on the linear complementarity problem, predicting static and sliding frictions as well as hysteresis behavior.
insights: 创新点：提出基于线性互补问题的摩擦接触模型
方法亮点：预测静态和滑动摩擦以及滞后行为
关键发现：提高连续体机器人的运动规划和控制
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes a frictional contact model based on the linear complementarity problem
Method highlight: Predicts static and sliding frictions and hysteresis behavior
Key finding: Improves motion planning and control of continuum robots
abstract: Accurate friction modeling in continuum robots is essential for precise motion control and path planning. However, current approaches make predictions only for the mechanism’s internal friction that is limited by the boundary forces of the Coulomb friction cone, which fail to characterize the static friction and motion hysteresis. In this paper, we propose a novel friction model based on complementarity constraints under the Coulomb friction assumption. This model predicts various friction effects caused by environmental interactions, including both static and sliding frictions and hysteresis behavior, as well as the corresponding robot deformation induced by these interactions, which are crucial for the practical motion planning and control of continuum robots. Additionally, real-time implementation of this model can be achieved, meeting the demand for computational efficiency in robotic applications. Experimental validations demonstrated that this model is able to reduce the maximum tip position error from 45.4 mm in the frictionless model to 5.85 mm in our friction-included model with a 287.9 mm-long tendon-driven continuum robot. The source code for the proposed model is publicly available at https://github.com/Jia0Shen/LCP-Continuum .
